half_verses: He that planted the ear, does he not hear?
he that formed the eye, does he not see?
verses.text: He that planted the ear, does he not hear? * he that formed the eye, does he not see?

half_verses: He who admonishes the nations, will he not punish?
he who teaches all the world, has he no knowledge?
verses.text: He who admonishes the nations, will he not punish? * he who teaches all the world, has he no knowledge?

half_verses: The LORD knows our human thoughts;
how like a puff of wind they are.
verses.text: The LORD knows our human thoughts; * how like a puff of wind they are.

half_verses: Happy are they whom you instruct, O Lord!
whom you teach out of your law;
verses.text: Happy are they whom you instruct, O Lord! * whom you teach out of your law;

half_verses: To give them rest in evil days,
until a pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.text: To give them rest in evil days, * until a pit is dug for the wicked.

half_verses: For the LORD will not abandon his people,
nor will he forsake his own.
verses.text: For the LORD will not abandon his people, * nor will he forsake his own.

half_verses: For judgment will again be just,
and all the true of heart will follow it.
verses.text: For judgment will again be just, * and all the true of heart will follow it.

half_verses: Who rose up for me against the wicked?
who took my part against the evildoers?
verses.text: Who rose up for me against the wicked? * who took my part against the evildoers?

half_verses: If the LORD had not come to my help,
I should soon have dwelt in the land of silence.
verses.text: If the LORD had not come to my help, * I should soon have dwelt in the land of silence.

half_verses: As often as I said, "My foot has slipped,"
your love, O LORD, upheld me.
verses.text: As often as I said, "My foot has slipped," * your love, O LORD, upheld me.

half_verses: When many cares fill my mind,
your consolations cheer my soul.
verses.text: When many cares fill my mind, * your consolations cheer my soul.

half_verses: Can a corrupt tribunal have any part with you,
one which frames evil into law?
verses.text: Can a corrupt tribunal have any part with you, * one which frames evil into law?

half_verses: They conspire against the life of the just
and condemn the innocent to death.
verses.text: They conspire against the life of the just * and condemn the innocent to death.

half_verses: But the LORD has become my stronghold,
and my God the rock of my trust.
verses.text: But the LORD has become my stronghold, * and my God the rock of my trust.

half_verses: He will turn their wickedness back upon them and destroy them in their own malice;
the LORD our God will destroy them.
verses.text: He will turn their wickedness back upon them and destroy them in their own malice; * the LORD our God will destroy them.

half_verses: Come, let us sing to the LORD;
let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.
verses.text: Come, let us sing to the LORD; * let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.

half_verses: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving
and raise a loud shout to him with psalms.
verses.text: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving * and raise a loud shout to him with psalms.

half_verses: For the LORD is a great God,
and a great King above all gods.
verses.text: For the LORD is a great God, * and a great King above all gods.

half_verses: In his hand are the caverns of the earth,
and the heights of the hills are his also.
verses.text: In his hand are the caverns of the earth, * and the heights of the hills are his also.

half_verses: The sea is his, for he made it,
and his hands have molded the dry land.
verses.text: The sea is his, for he made it, * and his hands have molded the dry land.

half_verses: Come, let us bow down, and bend the knee,
and kneel before the LORD our Maker.
verses.text: Come, let us bow down, and bend the knee, * and kneel before the LORD our Maker.

half_verses: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.
Oh, that today you would hearken to his voice!
verses.text: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand. * Oh, that today you would hearken to his voice!

half_verses: Harden not your hearts, as your forebears did in the wilderness,
at Meribah, and on that day at Massah, when they tempted me.
verses.text: Harden not your hearts, as your forebears did in the wilderness, * at Meribah, and on that day at Massah, when they tempted me.

half_verses: They put me to the test,
though they had seen my works.
verses.text: They put me to the test, * though they had seen my works.

half_verses: Forty years long I detested that generation and said,
"This people are wayward in their hearts; they do not know my ways."
verses.text: Forty years long I detested that generation and said, * "This people are wayward in their hearts; they do not know my ways."

half_verses: So I swore in my wrath,
"They shall not enter into my rest."
verses.text: So I swore in my wrath, * "They shall not enter into my rest."

half_verses: Sing to the LORD a new song;
sing to the LORD, all the whole earth.
verses.text: Sing to the LORD a new song; * sing to the LORD, all the whole earth.

half_verses: Sing to the LORD and bless his Name;
proclaim the good news of his salvation from day to day.
verses.text: Sing to the LORD and bless his Name; * proclaim the good news of his salvation from day to day.

half_verses: Declare his glory among the nations
and his wonders among all peoples.
verses.text: Declare his glory among the nations * and his wonders among all peoples.

half_verses: For great is the LORD and greatly to be praised;
he is more to be feared than all gods.
verses.text: For great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; * he is more to be feared than all gods.

half_verses: As for all the gods of the nations, they are but idols;
but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
verses.text: As for all the gods of the nations, they are but idols; * but it is the LORD who made the heavens.

half_verses: Oh, the majesty and magnificence of his presence!
Oh, the power and the splendor of his sanctuary!
verses.text: Oh, the majesty and magnificence of his presence! * Oh, the power and the splendor of his sanctuary!

half_verses: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples;
ascribe to the LORD honor and power.
verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples; * ascribe to the LORD honor and power.

half_verses: Ascribe to the LORD the honor due his Name;
bring offerings and come into his courts.
verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD the honor due his Name; * bring offerings and come into his courts.

half_verses: Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness;
let the whole earth tremble before him.
verses.text: Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness; * let the whole earth tremble before him.

half_verses: Tell it out among the nations: "The LORD is King!
he has made the world so firm that it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity."
verses.text: Tell it out among the nations: "The LORD is King! * he has made the world so firm that it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity."

half_verses: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea thunder and all that is in it;
let the field be joyful and all that is therein.
verses.text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea thunder and all that is in it; * let the field be joyful and all that is therein.

half_verses: Then shall all the trees of the wood shout for joy before the LORD when he comes,
when he comes to judge the earth.
verses.text: Then shall all the trees of the wood shout for joy before the LORD when he comes, * when he comes to judge the earth.

half_verses: He will judge the world with righteousness
and the peoples with his truth.
verses.text: He will judge the world with righteousness * and the peoples with his truth.

half_verses: The LORD is King; let the earth rejoice;
let the multitude of the isles be glad.
verses.text: The LORD is King; let the earth rejoice; * let the multitude of the isles be glad.

half_verses: Clouds and darkness are round about him,
righteousness and justice are the foundations of his throne.
verses.text: Clouds and darkness are round about him, * righteousness and justice are the foundations of his throne.

half_verses: A fire goes before him
and burns up his enemies on every side.
verses.text: A fire goes before him * and burns up his enemies on every side.

half_verses: His lightnings light up the world;
the earth sees it and is afraid.
verses.text: His lightnings light up the world; * the earth sees it and is afraid.

half_verses: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD,
at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, * at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

half_verses: The heavens declare his righteousness,
and all the peoples see his glory.
verses.text: The heavens declare his righteousness, * and all the peoples see his glory.

half_verses: Confounded be all who worship carved images and delight in false gods!
Bow down before him, all you gods.
verses.text: Confounded be all who worship carved images and delight in false gods! * Bow down before him, all you gods.

half_verses: Zion hears and is glad, and the cities of Judah rejoice,
because of your judgments, O LORD.
verses.text: Zion hears and is glad, and the cities of Judah rejoice, * because of your judgments, O LORD.

half_verses: For you are the LORD, most high over all the earth;
you are exalted far above all gods.
verses.text: For you are the LORD, most high over all the earth; * you are exalted far above all gods.

half_verses: The LORD loves those who hate evil;
he preserves the lives of his saints and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.text: The LORD loves those who hate evil; * he preserves the lives of his saints and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

half_verses: Light has sprung up for the righteous,
and joyful gladness for those who are truehearted.
verses.text: Light has sprung up for the righteous, * and joyful gladness for those who are truehearted.

half_verses: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous,
and give thanks to his holy Name.
verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous, * and give thanks to his holy Name.

half_verses: Sing to the LORD a new song,
for he has done marvelous things.
verses.text: Sing to the LORD a new song, * for he has done marvelous things.

half_verses: With his right hand and his holy arm
has he won for himself the victory.
verses.text: With his right hand and his holy arm * has he won for himself the victory.

half_verses: The LORD has made known his victory;
his righteousness has he openly shown in the sight of the nations.
verses.text: The LORD has made known his victory; * his righteousness has he openly shown in the sight of the nations.

half_verses: He remembers his mercy and faithfulness to the house of Israel,
and all the ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.
verses.text: He remembers his mercy and faithfulness to the house of Israel, * and all the ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.

half_verses: Shout with joy to the LORD, all you lands;
lift up your voice, rejoice, and sing.
verses.text: Shout with joy to the LORD, all you lands; * lift up your voice, rejoice, and sing.

half_verses: Sing to the LORD with the harp,
with the harp and the voice of song.
verses.text: Sing to the LORD with the harp, * with the harp and the voice of song.

half_verses: With trumpets and the sound of the horn
shout with joy before the King, the LORD.
verses.text: With trumpets and the sound of the horn * shout with joy before the King, the LORD.

half_verses: Let the sea make a noise and all that is in it,
the lands and those who dwell therein.
verses.text: Let the sea make a noise and all that is in it, * the lands and those who dwell therein.

half_verses: Let the rivers clap their hands,
and let the hills ring out with joy before the LORD, when he comes to judge the earth.
verses.text: Let the rivers clap their hands, * and let the hills ring out with joy before the LORD, when he comes to judge the earth.

half_verses: In righteousness shall he judge the world
and the peoples with equity.
verses.text: In righteousness shall he judge the world * and the peoples with equity.

half_verses: The LORD is King; let the people tremble;
he is enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth shake.
verses.text: The LORD is King; let the people tremble; * he is enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth shake.

half_verses: The LORD is great in Zion;
he is high above all peoples.
verses.text: The LORD is great in Zion; * he is high above all peoples.

half_verses: Let them confess his Name, which is great and awesome;
he is the Holy One.
verses.text: Let them confess his Name, which is great and awesome; * he is the Holy One.

half_verses: "O mighty King, lover of justice, you have established equity;
you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob."
verses.text: "O mighty King, lover of justice, you have established equity; * you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob."

half_verses: Proclaim the greatness of the LORD our God and fall down before his footstool;
he is the Holy One.
verses.text: Proclaim the greatness of the LORD our God and fall down before his footstool; * he is the Holy One.

half_verses: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among those who call upon his Name,
they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
verses.text: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among those who call upon his Name, * they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.

half_verses: He spoke to them out of the pillar of cloud;
they kept his testimonies and the decree that he gave them.
verses.text: He spoke to them out of the pillar of cloud; * they kept his testimonies and the decree that he gave them.

half_verses: "O LORD our God, you answered them indeed;
you were a God who forgave them, yet punished them for their evil deeds."
verses.text: "O LORD our God, you answered them indeed; * you were a God who forgave them, yet punished them for their evil deeds."

half_verses: Proclaim the greatness of the LORD our God and worship him upon his holy hill;
for the LORD our God is the Holy One.
verses.text: Proclaim the greatness of the LORD our God and worship him upon his holy hill; * for the LORD our God is the Holy One.

half_verses: Be joyful in the LORD, all you lands;
serve the LORD with gladness and come before his presence with a song.
verses.text: Be joyful in the LORD, all you lands; * serve the LORD with gladness and come before his presence with a song.

half_verses: Know this: The LORD himself is God;
he himself has made us, and we are his; we are his people and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.text: Know this: The LORD himself is God; * he himself has made us, and we are his; we are his people and the sheep of his pasture.

half_verses: Enter his gates with thanksgiving; go into his courts with praise;
give thanks to him and call upon his Name.
verses.text: Enter his gates with thanksgiving; go into his courts with praise; * give thanks to him and call upon his Name.

half_verses: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting;
and his faithfulness endures from age to age.
verses.text: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; * and his faithfulness endures from age to age.

half_verses: I will sing of mercy and justice;
to you, O LORD, will I sing praises.
verses.text: I will sing of mercy and justice; * to you, O LORD, will I sing praises.

half_verses: I will strive to follow a blameless course; oh, when will you come to me?
I will walk with sincerity of heart within my house.
verses.text: I will strive to follow a blameless course; oh, when will you come to me? * I will walk with sincerity of heart within my house.

half_verses: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes;
I hate the doers of evil deeds; they shall not remain with me.
verses.text: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes; * I hate the doers of evil deeds; they shall not remain with me.

half_verses: A crooked heart shall be far from me;
I will not know evil.
verses.text: A crooked heart shall be far from me; * I will not know evil.

half_verses: Those who in secret slander their neighbors I will destroy;
those who have a haughty look and a proud heart I cannot abide.
verses.text: Those who in secret slander their neighbors I will destroy; * those who have a haughty look and a proud heart I cannot abide.

half_verses: My eyes are upon the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me,
and only those who lead a blameless life shall be my servants.
verses.text: My eyes are upon the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me, * and only those who lead a blameless life shall be my servants.

half_verses: Those who act deceitfully shall not dwell in my house,
and those who tell lies shall not continue in my sight.
verses.text: Those who act deceitfully shall not dwell in my house, * and those who tell lies shall not continue in my sight.

half_verses: I will soon destroy all the wicked in the land,
that I may root out all evildoers from the city of the LORD.
verses.text: I will soon destroy all the wicked in the land, * that I may root out all evildoers from the city of the LORD.

half_verses: LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry come before you;
hide not your face from me in the day of my trouble.
verses.text: LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry come before you; * hide not your face from me in the day of my trouble.

half_verses: Incline your ear to me;
when I call, make haste to answer me,
verses.text: Incline your ear to me; * when I call, make haste to answer me,

half_verses: For my days drift away like smoke,
and my bones are hot as burning coals.
verses.text: For my days drift away like smoke, * and my bones are hot as burning coals.

half_verses: My heart is smitten like grass and withered,
so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.text: My heart is smitten like grass and withered, * so that I forget to eat my bread.

half_verses: Because of the voice of my groaning
I am but skin and bones.
verses.text: Because of the voice of my groaning * I am but skin and bones.

half_verses: I have become like a vulture in the wilderness,
like an owl among the ruins.
verses.text: I have become like a vulture in the wilderness, * like an owl among the ruins.

half_verses: I lie awake and groan;
I am like a sparrow, lonely on a house-top.
verses.text: I lie awake and groan; * I am like a sparrow, lonely on a house-top.

half_verses: My enemies revile me all day long,
and those who scoff at me have taken an oath against me.
verses.text: My enemies revile me all day long, * and those who scoff at me have taken an oath against me.

half_verses: For I have eaten ashes for bread
and mingled my drink with weeping.
verses.text: For I have eaten ashes for bread * and mingled my drink with weeping.

half_verses: Because of your indignation and wrath
you have lifted me up and thrown me away.
verses.text: Because of your indignation and wrath * you have lifted me up and thrown me away.

half_verses: My days pass away like a shadow,
and I wither like the grass.
verses.text: My days pass away like a shadow, * and I wither like the grass.

half_verses: But you, O LORD, endure for ever,
and your Name from age to age.
verses.text: But you, O LORD, endure for ever, * and your Name from age to age.

half_verses: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to have mercy upon her;
indeed, the appointed time has come.
verses.text: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to have mercy upon her; * indeed, the appointed time has come.

half_verses: For your servants love her very rubble,
and are moved to pity even for her dust.
verses.text: For your servants love her very rubble, * and are moved to pity even for her dust.

half_verses: The nations shall fear your Name, O LORD,
and all the kings of the earth your glory.
verses.text: The nations shall fear your Name, O LORD, * and all the kings of the earth your glory.

half_verses: For the LORD will build up Zion,
and his glory will appear.
verses.text: For the LORD will build up Zion, * and his glory will appear.

half_verses: He will look with favor on the prayer of the homeless;
he will not despise their plea.
verses.text: He will look with favor on the prayer of the homeless; * he will not despise their plea.

half_verses: Let this be written for a future generation,
so that a people yet unborn may praise the LORD.
verses.text: Let this be written for a future generation, * so that a people yet unborn may praise the LORD.

half_verses: For the LORD looked down from his holy place on high;
from the heavens he beheld the earth;
verses.text: For the LORD looked down from his holy place on high; * from the heavens he beheld the earth;

half_verses: That he might hear the groan of the captive
and set free those condemned to die;
verses.text: That he might hear the groan of the captive * and set free those condemned to die;

half_verses: That they may declare in Zion the Name of the LORD,
and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.text: That they may declare in Zion the Name of the LORD, * and his praise in Jerusalem;

half_verses: When the peoples are gathered together,
and the kingdoms also, to serve the LORD.
verses.text: When the peoples are gathered together, * and the kingdoms also, to serve the LORD.

half_verses: He has brought down my strength before my time;
he has shortened the number of my days;
verses.text: He has brought down my strength before my time; * he has shortened the number of my days;

half_verses: And I said, "O my God, do not take me away in the midst of my days;
your years endure throughout all generations.
verses.text: And I said, "O my God, do not take me away in the midst of my days; * your years endure throughout all generations.

half_verses: In the beginning, O LORD, you laid the foundations of the earth,
and the heavens are the work of your hands;
verses.text: In the beginning, O LORD, you laid the foundations of the earth, * and the heavens are the work of your hands;

half_verses: They shall perish, but you will endure; they all shall wear out like a garment;
as clothing you will change them, and they shall be changed;
verses.text: They shall perish, but you will endure; they all shall wear out like a garment; * as clothing you will change them, and they shall be changed;

half_verses: But you are always the same,
and your years will never end.
verses.text: But you are always the same, * and your years will never end.

half_verses: The children of your servants shall continue,
and their offspring shall stand fast in your sight."
verses.text: The children of your servants shall continue, * and their offspring shall stand fast in your sight."

half_verses: Bless the LORD, O my soul,
and all that is within me, bless his holy Name.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, * and all that is within me, bless his holy Name.

half_verses: Bless the LORD, O my soul,
and forget not all his benefits.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, * and forget not all his benefits.

half_verses: He forgives all your sins
and heals all your infirmities;
verses.text: He forgives all your sins * and heals all your infirmities;

half_verses: He redeems your life from the grave
and crowns you with mercy and loving-kindness;
verses.text: He redeems your life from the grave * and crowns you with mercy and loving-kindness;

half_verses: He satisfies you with good things,
and your youth is renewed like an eagle's.
verses.text: He satisfies you with good things, * and your youth is renewed like an eagle's.

half_verses: The LORD executes righteousness
and judgment for all who are oppressed.
verses.text: The LORD executes righteousness * and judgment for all who are oppressed.

half_verses: He made his ways known to Moses
and his works to the children of Israel.
verses.text: He made his ways known to Moses * and his works to the children of Israel.

half_verses: The LORD is full of compassion and mercy,
slow to anger and of great kindness.
verses.text: The LORD is full of compassion and mercy, * slow to anger and of great kindness.

half_verses: He will not always accuse us,
nor will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.text: He will not always accuse us, * nor will he keep his anger for ever.

half_verses: He has not dealt with us according to our sins,
nor rewarded us according to our wickedness.
verses.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, * nor rewarded us according to our wickedness.

half_verses: For as the heavens are high above the earth,
so is his mercy great upon those who fear him.
verses.text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, * so is his mercy great upon those who fear him.

half_verses: As far as the east is from the west,
so far has he removed our sins from us.
verses.text: As far as the east is from the west, * so far has he removed our sins from us.

half_verses: As a father cares for his children,
so does the LORD care for those who fear him.
verses.text: As a father cares for his children, * so does the LORD care for those who fear him.

half_verses: For he himself knows whereof we are made;
he remembers that we are but dust.
verses.text: For he himself knows whereof we are made; * he remembers that we are but dust.

half_verses: Our days are like the grass;
we flourish like a flower of the field;
verses.text: Our days are like the grass; * we flourish like a flower of the field;

half_verses: When the wind goes over it, it is gone,
and its place shall know it no more.
verses.text: When the wind goes over it, it is gone, * and its place shall know it no more.

half_verses: But the merciful goodness of the LORD endures for ever on those who fear him,
and his righteousness on children's children;
verses.text: But the merciful goodness of the LORD endures for ever on those who fear him, * and his righteousness on children's children;

half_verses: On those who keep his covenant
and remember his commandments and do them.
verses.text: On those who keep his covenant * and remember his commandments and do them.

half_verses: The LORD has set his throne in heaven,
and his kingship has dominion over all.
verses.text: The LORD has set his throne in heaven, * and his kingship has dominion over all.

half_verses: Bless the LORD, you angels of his, you mighty ones who do his bidding,
and hearken to the voice of his word.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, you angels of his, you mighty ones who do his bidding, * and hearken to the voice of his word.

half_verses: Bless the LORD, all you his hosts,
you ministers of his who do his will.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, all you his hosts, * you ministers of his who do his will.

half_verses: Bless the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion;
bless the LORD, O my soul.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion; * bless the LORD, O my soul.

half_verses: Bless the LORD, O my soul;
O LORD my God, how excellent is your greatness! you are clothed with majesty and splendor.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul; * O LORD my God, how excellent is your greatness! you are clothed with majesty and splendor.

half_verses: You wrap yourself with light as with a cloak
and spread out the heavens like a curtain.
verses.text: You wrap yourself with light as with a cloak * and spread out the heavens like a curtain.

half_verses: You lay the beams of your chambers in the waters above;
you make the clouds your chariot; you ride on the wings of the wind.
verses.text: You lay the beams of your chambers in the waters above; * you make the clouds your chariot; you ride on the wings of the wind.

half_verses: You make the winds your messengers
and flames of fire your servants.
verses.text: You make the winds your messengers * and flames of fire your servants.

half_verses: You have set the earth upon its foundations,
so that it never shall move at any time.
verses.text: You have set the earth upon its foundations, * so that it never shall move at any time.

half_verses: You covered it with the Deep as with a mantle;
the waters stood higher than the mountains.
verses.text: You covered it with the Deep as with a mantle; * the waters stood higher than the mountains.

half_verses: At your rebuke they fled;
at the voice of your thunder they hastened away.
verses.text: At your rebuke they fled; * at the voice of your thunder they hastened away.

half_verses: They went up into the hills and down to the valleys beneath,
to the places you had appointed for them.
verses.text: They went up into the hills and down to the valleys beneath, * to the places you had appointed for them.

half_verses: You set the limits that they should not pass;
they shall not again cover the earth.
verses.text: You set the limits that they should not pass; * they shall not again cover the earth.

half_verses: You send the springs into the valleys;
they flow between the mountains.
verses.text: You send the springs into the valleys; * they flow between the mountains.

half_verses: All the beasts of the field drink their fill from them,
and the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.text: All the beasts of the field drink their fill from them, * and the wild asses quench their thirst.

half_verses: Beside them the birds of the air make their nests
and sing among the branches.
verses.text: Beside them the birds of the air make their nests * and sing among the branches.

half_verses: You water the mountains from your dwelling on high;
the earth is fully satisfied by the fruit of your works.
verses.text: You water the mountains from your dwelling on high; * the earth is fully satisfied by the fruit of your works.

half_verses: You make grass grow for flocks and herds
and plants to serve mankind;
verses.text: You make grass grow for flocks and herds * and plants to serve mankind;

half_verses: That they may bring forth food from the earth,
and wine to gladden our hearts,
verses.text: That they may bring forth food from the earth, * and wine to gladden our hearts,

half_verses: Oil to make a cheerful countenance,
and bread to strengthen the heart.
verses.text: Oil to make a cheerful countenance, * and bread to strengthen the heart.

half_verses: The trees of the LORD are full of sap,
the cedars of Lebanon which he planted,
verses.text: The trees of the LORD are full of sap, * the cedars of Lebanon which he planted,

half_verses: In which the birds build their nests,
and in whose tops the stork makes his dwelling.
verses.text: In which the birds build their nests, * and in whose tops the stork makes his dwelling.

half_verses: The high hills are a refuge for the mountain goats,
and the stony cliffs for the rock badgers.
verses.text: The high hills are a refuge for the mountain goats, * and the stony cliffs for the rock badgers.

half_verses: You appointed the moon to mark the seasons,
and the sun knows the time of its setting.
verses.text: You appointed the moon to mark the seasons, * and the sun knows the time of its setting.

half_verses: You make darkness that it may be night,
in which all the beasts of the forest prowl.
verses.text: You make darkness that it may be night, * in which all the beasts of the forest prowl.

half_verses: The lions roar after their prey
and seek their food from God.
verses.text: The lions roar after their prey * and seek their food from God.

half_verses: The sun rises, and they slip away
and lay themselves down in their dens.
verses.text: The sun rises, and they slip away * and lay themselves down in their dens.

half_verses: Man goes forth to his work
and to his labor until the evening.
verses.text: Man goes forth to his work * and to his labor until the evening.

half_verses: O LORD, how manifold are your works!
in wisdom you have made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verses.text: O LORD, how manifold are your works! * in wisdom you have made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.

half_verses: Yonder is the great and wide sea with its living things too many to number,
creatures both small and great.
verses.text: Yonder is the great and wide sea with its living things too many to number, * creatures both small and great.

half_verses: There move the ships, and there is that Leviathan,
which you have made for the sport of it.
verses.text: There move the ships, and there is that Leviathan, * which you have made for the sport of it.

half_verses: All of them look to you
to give them their food in due season.
verses.text: All of them look to you * to give them their food in due season.

half_verses: You give it to them; they gather it;
you open your hand, and they are filled with good things.
verses.text: You give it to them; they gather it; * you open your hand, and they are filled with good things.

half_verses: You hide your face, and they are terrified;
you take away their breath, and they die and return to their dust.
verses.text: You hide your face, and they are terrified; * you take away their breath, and they die and return to their dust.

half_verses: You send forth your Spirit, and they are created;
and so you renew the face of the earth.
verses.text: You send forth your Spirit, and they are created; * and so you renew the face of the earth.

half_verses: May the glory of the LORD endure for ever;
may the LORD rejoice in all his works.
verses.text: May the glory of the LORD endure for ever; * may the LORD rejoice in all his works.

half_verses: He looks at the earth and it trembles;
he touches the mountains and they smoke.
verses.text: He looks at the earth and it trembles; * he touches the mountains and they smoke.

half_verses: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live;
I will praise my God while I have my being.
verses.text: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; * I will praise my God while I have my being.

half_verses: May these words of mine please him;
I will rejoice in the LORD.
verses.text: May these words of mine please him; * I will rejoice in the LORD.

half_verses: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth,
and the wicked be no more.
verses.text: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth, * and the wicked be no more.

half_verses: Bless the LORD, O my soul.
Hallelujah!
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul. * Hallelujah!

half_verses: Give thanks to the LORD and call upon his Name;
make known his deeds among the peoples.
verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD and call upon his Name; * make known his deeds among the peoples.

half_verses: Sing to him, sing praises to him,
and speak of all his marvelous works.
verses.text: Sing to him, sing praises to him, * and speak of all his marvelous works.

half_verses: Glory in his holy Name;
let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
verses.text: Glory in his holy Name; * let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

half_verses: Search for the LORD and his strength;
continually seek his face.
verses.text: Search for the LORD and his strength; * continually seek his face.

half_verses: Remember the marvels he has done,
his wonders and the judgments of his mouth,
verses.text: Remember the marvels he has done, * his wonders and the judgments of his mouth,

half_verses: O offspring of Abraham his servant,
O children of Jacob his chosen.
verses.text: O offspring of Abraham his servant, * O children of Jacob his chosen.

half_verses: He is the LORD our God;
his judgments prevail in all the world.
verses.text: He is the LORD our God; * his judgments prevail in all the world.

half_verses: He has always been mindful of his covenant,
the promise he made for a thousand generations:
verses.text: He has always been mindful of his covenant, * the promise he made for a thousand generations:

half_verses: The covenant he made with Abraham,
the oath that he swore to Isaac,
verses.text: The covenant he made with Abraham, * the oath that he swore to Isaac,

half_verses: Which he established as a statute for Jacob,
an everlasting covenant for Israel,
verses.text: Which he established as a statute for Jacob, * an everlasting covenant for Israel,

half_verses: Saying, "To you will I give the land of Canaan
to be your allotted inheritance."
verses.text: Saying, "To you will I give the land of Canaan * to be your allotted inheritance."

half_verses: When they were few in number,
of little account, and sojourners in the land,
verses.text: When they were few in number, * of little account, and sojourners in the land,

half_verses: Wandering from nation to nation
and from one kingdom to another,
verses.text: Wandering from nation to nation * and from one kingdom to another,

half_verses: He let no one oppress them
and rebuked kings for their sake,
verses.text: He let no one oppress them * and rebuked kings for their sake,

half_verses: Saying, "Do not touch my anointed
and do my prophets no harm."
verses.text: Saying, "Do not touch my anointed * and do my prophets no harm."

half_verses: Then he called for a famine in the land
and destroyed the supply of bread.
verses.text: Then he called for a famine in the land * and destroyed the supply of bread.

half_verses: He sent a man before them,
Joseph, who was sold as a slave.
verses.text: He sent a man before them, * Joseph, who was sold as a slave.

half_verses: They bruised his feet in fetters;
his neck they put in an iron collar.
verses.text: They bruised his feet in fetters; * his neck they put in an iron collar.

half_verses: Until his prediction came to pass,
the word of the LORD tested him.
verses.text: Until his prediction came to pass, * the word of the LORD tested him.

half_verses: The king sent and released him;
the ruler of the peoples set him free.
verses.text: The king sent and released him; * the ruler of the peoples set him free.

half_verses: He set him as a master over his household,
as a ruler over all his possessions,
verses.text: He set him as a master over his household, * as a ruler over all his possessions,

half_verses: To instruct his princes according to his will
and to teach his elders wisdom.
verses.text: To instruct his princes according to his will * and to teach his elders wisdom.

half_verses: Israel came into Egypt,
and Jacob became a sojourner in the land of Ham.
verses.text: Israel came into Egypt, * and Jacob became a sojourner in the land of Ham.

half_verses: The LORD made his people exceedingly fruitful;
he made them stronger than their enemies;
verses.text: The LORD made his people exceedingly fruitful; * he made them stronger than their enemies;

half_verses: Whose heart he turned, so that they hated his people,
and dealt unjustly with his servants.
verses.text: Whose heart he turned, so that they hated his people, * and dealt unjustly with his servants.

half_verses: He sent Moses his servant,
and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.text: He sent Moses his servant, * and Aaron whom he had chosen.

half_verses: They worked his signs among them,
and portents in the land of Ham.
verses.text: They worked his signs among them, * and portents in the land of Ham.

half_verses: He sent darkness, and it grew dark;
but the Egyptians rebelled against his words.
verses.text: He sent darkness, and it grew dark; * but the Egyptians rebelled against his words.

half_verses: He turned their waters into blood
and caused their fish to die.
verses.text: He turned their waters into blood * and caused their fish to die.

half_verses: Their land was overrun by frogs,
in the very chambers of their kings.
verses.text: Their land was overrun by frogs, * in the very chambers of their kings.

half_verses: He spoke, and there came swarms of insects
and gnats within all their borders.
verses.text: He spoke, and there came swarms of insects * and gnats within all their borders.

half_verses: He gave them hailstones instead of rain,
and flames of fire throughout their land.
verses.text: He gave them hailstones instead of rain, * and flames of fire throughout their land.

half_verses: He blasted their vines and their fig trees
and shattered every tree in their country.
verses.text: He blasted their vines and their fig trees * and shattered every tree in their country.

half_verses: He spoke, and the locust came,
and young locusts without number,
verses.text: He spoke, and the locust came, * and young locusts without number,

half_verses: Which ate up all the green plants in their land
and devoured the fruit of their soil.
verses.text: Which ate up all the green plants in their land * and devoured the fruit of their soil.

half_verses: He struck down the firstborn of their land,
the firstfruits of all their strength.
verses.text: He struck down the firstborn of their land, * the firstfruits of all their strength.

half_verses: He led out his people with silver and gold;
in all their tribes there was not one that stumbled.
verses.text: He led out his people with silver and gold; * in all their tribes there was not one that stumbled.

half_verses: Egypt was glad of their going,
because they were afraid of them.
verses.text: Egypt was glad of their going, * because they were afraid of them.

half_verses: He spread out a cloud for a covering
and a fire to give light in the night season.
verses.text: He spread out a cloud for a covering * and a fire to give light in the night season.

half_verses: They asked, and quails appeared,
and he satisfied them with bread from heaven.
verses.text: They asked, and quails appeared, * and he satisfied them with bread from heaven.

half_verses: He opened the rock, and water flowed,
so the river ran in the dry places.
verses.text: He opened the rock, and water flowed, * so the river ran in the dry places.

half_verses: For God remembered his holy word
and Abraham his servant.
verses.text: For God remembered his holy word * and Abraham his servant.

half_verses: So he led forth his people with gladness,
his chosen with shouts of joy.
verses.text: So he led forth his people with gladness, * his chosen with shouts of joy.

half_verses: He gave his people the lands of the nations,
and they took the fruit of others' toil,
verses.text: He gave his people the lands of the nations, * and they took the fruit of others' toil,

half_verses: That they might keep his statutes
and observe his laws. Hallelujah!
verses.text: That they might keep his statutes * and observe his laws. Hallelujah!

half_verses: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good,
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, * for his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Who can declare the mighty acts of the LORD
or show forth all his praise?
verses.text: Who can declare the mighty acts of the LORD * or show forth all his praise?

half_verses: Happy are those who act with justice
and always do what is right!
verses.text: Happy are those who act with justice * and always do what is right!

half_verses: Remember me, O LORD, with the favor you have for your people,
and visit me with your saving help;
verses.text: Remember me, O LORD, with the favor you have for your people, * and visit me with your saving help;

half_verses: That I may see the prosperity of your elect and be glad with the gladness of your people,
that I may glory with your inheritance.
verses.text: That I may see the prosperity of your elect and be glad with the gladness of your people, * that I may glory with your inheritance.

half_verses: We have sinned as our forebears did;
we have done wrong and dealt wickedly.
verses.text: We have sinned as our forebears did; * we have done wrong and dealt wickedly.

half_verses: In Egypt they did not consider your marvelous works, nor remember the abundance of your love;
they defied the Most High at the Red Sea.
verses.text: In Egypt they did not consider your marvelous works, nor remember the abundance of your love; * they defied the Most High at the Red Sea.

half_verses: But he saved them for his Name's sake,
to make his power known.
verses.text: But he saved them for his Name's sake, * to make his power known.

half_verses: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up,
and he led them through the deep as through a desert.
verses.text: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up, * and he led them through the deep as through a desert.

half_verses: He saved them from the hand of those who hated them
and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.text: He saved them from the hand of those who hated them * and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

half_verses: The waters covered their oppressors;
not one of them was left.
verses.text: The waters covered their oppressors; * not one of them was left.

half_verses: Then they believed his words
and sang him songs of praise.
verses.text: Then they believed his words * and sang him songs of praise.

half_verses: But they soon forgot his deeds
and did not wait for his counsel.
verses.text: But they soon forgot his deeds * and did not wait for his counsel.

half_verses: A craving seized them in the wilderness,
and they put God to the test in the desert.
verses.text: A craving seized them in the wilderness, * and they put God to the test in the desert.

half_verses: He gave them what they asked,
but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.text: He gave them what they asked, * but sent leanness into their soul.

half_verses: They envied Moses in the camp,
and Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
verses.text: They envied Moses in the camp, * and Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.

half_verses: The earth opened and swallowed Dathan
and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.text: The earth opened and swallowed Dathan * and covered the company of Abiram.

half_verses: Fire blazed up against their company,
and flames devoured the wicked.
verses.text: Fire blazed up against their company, * and flames devoured the wicked.

half_verses: Israel made a bull-calf at Horeb
and worshiped a molten image;
verses.text: Israel made a bull-calf at Horeb * and worshiped a molten image;

half_verses: And so they exchanged their Glory
for the image of an ox that feeds on grass.
verses.text: And so they exchanged their Glory * for the image of an ox that feeds on grass.

half_verses: They forgot God their Savior,
who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.text: They forgot God their Savior, * who had done great things in Egypt,

half_verses: Wonderful deeds in the land of Ham,
and fearful things at the Red Sea.
verses.text: Wonderful deeds in the land of Ham, * and fearful things at the Red Sea.

half_verses: So he would have destroyed them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach,
to turn away his wrath from consuming them.
verses.text: So he would have destroyed them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, * to turn away his wrath from consuming them.

half_verses: They refused the pleasant land
and would not believe his promise.
verses.text: They refused the pleasant land * and would not believe his promise.

half_verses: They grumbled in their tents
and would not listen to the voice of the LORD.
verses.text: They grumbled in their tents * and would not listen to the voice of the LORD.

half_verses: So he lifted his hand against them,
to overthrow them in the wilderness,
verses.text: So he lifted his hand against them, * to overthrow them in the wilderness,

half_verses: To cast out their seed among the nations,
and to scatter them throughout the lands.
verses.text: To cast out their seed among the nations, * and to scatter them throughout the lands.

half_verses: They joined themselves to Baal-Peor
and ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
verses.text: They joined themselves to Baal-Peor * and ate sacrifices offered to the dead.

half_verses: They provoked him to anger with their actions,
and a plague broke out among them.
verses.text: They provoked him to anger with their actions, * and a plague broke out among them.

half_verses: Then Phinehas stood up and interceded,
and the plague came to an end.
verses.text: Then Phinehas stood up and interceded, * and the plague came to an end.

half_verses: This was reckoned to him as righteousness
throughout all generations for ever.
verses.text: This was reckoned to him as righteousness * throughout all generations for ever.

half_verses: Again they provoked his anger at the waters of Meribah,
so that he punished Moses because of them;
verses.text: Again they provoked his anger at the waters of Meribah, * so that he punished Moses because of them;

half_verses: For they so embittered his spirit
that he spoke rash words with his lips.
verses.text: For they so embittered his spirit * that he spoke rash words with his lips.

half_verses: They did not destroy the peoples
as the LORD had commanded them.
verses.text: They did not destroy the peoples * as the LORD had commanded them.

half_verses: They intermingled with the heathen
and learned their pagan ways,
verses.text: They intermingled with the heathen * and learned their pagan ways,

half_verses: So that they worshiped their idols,
which became a snare to them.
verses.text: So that they worshiped their idols, * which became a snare to them.

half_verses: They sacrificed their sons
and their daughters to evil spirits.
verses.text: They sacrificed their sons * and their daughters to evil spirits.

half_verses: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters,
which they offered to the idols of Canaan, and the land was defiled with blood.
verses.text: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, * which they offered to the idols of Canaan, and the land was defiled with blood.

half_verses: Thus they were polluted by their actions
and went whoring in their evil deeds.
verses.text: Thus they were polluted by their actions * and went whoring in their evil deeds.

half_verses: Therefore the wrath of the LORD was kindled against his people
and he abhorred his inheritance.
verses.text: Therefore the wrath of the LORD was kindled against his people * and he abhorred his inheritance.

half_verses: He gave them over to the hand of the heathen,
and those who hated them ruled over them.
verses.text: He gave them over to the hand of the heathen, * and those who hated them ruled over them.

half_verses: Their enemies oppressed them,
and they were humbled under their hand.
verses.text: Their enemies oppressed them, * and they were humbled under their hand.

half_verses: Many a time did he deliver them, but they rebelled through their own devices,
and were brought down in their iniquity.
verses.text: Many a time did he deliver them, but they rebelled through their own devices, * and were brought down in their iniquity.

half_verses: Nevertheless, he saw their distress,
when he heard their lamentation.
verses.text: Nevertheless, he saw their distress, * when he heard their lamentation.

half_verses: He remembered his covenant with them
and relented in accordance with his great mercy.
verses.text: He remembered his covenant with them * and relented in accordance with his great mercy.

half_verses: He caused them to be pitied
by those who held them captive.
verses.text: He caused them to be pitied * by those who held them captive.

half_verses: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the nations,
that we may give thanks to your holy Name and glory in your praise.
verses.text: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the nations, * that we may give thanks to your holy Name and glory in your praise.

half_verses: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting;
and let all the people say, "Amen!" Hallelujah!
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting; * and let all the people say, "Amen!" Hallelujah!

half_verses: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good,
and his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, * and his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Let all those whom the LORD has redeemed proclaim
that he redeemed them from the hand of the foe.
verses.text: Let all those whom the LORD has redeemed proclaim * that he redeemed them from the hand of the foe.

half_verses: He gathered them out of the lands;
from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
verses.text: He gathered them out of the lands; * from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

half_verses: Some wandered in desert wastes;
they found no way to a city where they might dwell.
verses.text: Some wandered in desert wastes; * they found no way to a city where they might dwell.

half_verses: They were hungry and thirsty;
their spirits languished within them.
verses.text: They were hungry and thirsty; * their spirits languished within them.

half_verses: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble,
and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.text: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, * and he delivered them from their distress.

half_verses: He put their feet on a straight path
to go to a city where they might dwell.
verses.text: He put their feet on a straight path * to go to a city where they might dwell.

half_verses: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his mercy
and the wonders he does for his children.
verses.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his mercy * and the wonders he does for his children.

half_verses: For he satisfies the thirsty
and fills the hungry with good things.
verses.text: For he satisfies the thirsty * and fills the hungry with good things.

half_verses: Some sat in darkness and deep gloom,
bound fast in misery and iron;
verses.text: Some sat in darkness and deep gloom, * bound fast in misery and iron;

half_verses: Because they rebelled against the words of God
and despised the counsel of the Most High.
verses.text: Because they rebelled against the words of God * and despised the counsel of the Most High.

half_verses: So he humbled their spirits with hard labor;
they stumbled, and there was none to help.
verses.text: So he humbled their spirits with hard labor; * they stumbled, and there was none to help.

half_verses: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble,
and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.text: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, * and he delivered them from their distress.

half_verses: He led them out of darkness and deep gloom
and broke their bonds asunder.
verses.text: He led them out of darkness and deep gloom * and broke their bonds asunder.

half_verses: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his mercy
and the wonders he does for his children.
verses.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his mercy * and the wonders he does for his children.

half_verses: For he shatters the doors of bronze
and breaks in two the iron bars.
verses.text: For he shatters the doors of bronze * and breaks in two the iron bars.

half_verses: Some were fools and took to rebellious ways;
they were afflicted because of their sins.
verses.text: Some were fools and took to rebellious ways; * they were afflicted because of their sins.

half_verses: They abhorred all manner of food
and drew near to death's door.
verses.text: They abhorred all manner of food * and drew near to death's door.

half_verses: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble,
and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.text: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, * and he delivered them from their distress.

half_verses: He sent forth his word and healed them
and saved them from the grave.
verses.text: He sent forth his word and healed them * and saved them from the grave.

half_verses: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his mercy
and the wonders he does for his children.
verses.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his mercy * and the wonders he does for his children.

half_verses: Let them offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving
and tell of his acts with shouts of joy.
verses.text: Let them offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving * and tell of his acts with shouts of joy.

half_verses: Some went down to the sea in ships
and plied their trade in deep waters;
verses.text: Some went down to the sea in ships * and plied their trade in deep waters;

half_verses: They beheld the works of the LORD
and his wonders in the deep.
verses.text: They beheld the works of the LORD * and his wonders in the deep.

half_verses: Then he spoke, and a stormy wind arose,
which tossed high the waves of the sea.
verses.text: Then he spoke, and a stormy wind arose, * which tossed high the waves of the sea.

half_verses: They mounted up to the heavens and fell back to the depths;
their hearts melted because of their peril.
verses.text: They mounted up to the heavens and fell back to the depths; * their hearts melted because of their peril.

half_verses: They reeled and staggered like drunkards
and were at their wits' end.
verses.text: They reeled and staggered like drunkards * and were at their wits' end.

half_verses: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble,
and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.text: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, * and he delivered them from their distress.

half_verses: He stilled the storm to a whisper
and quieted the waves of the sea.
verses.text: He stilled the storm to a whisper * and quieted the waves of the sea.

half_verses: Then were they glad because of the calm,
and he brought them to the harbor they were bound for.
verses.text: Then were they glad because of the calm, * and he brought them to the harbor they were bound for.

half_verses: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his mercy
and the wonders he does for his children.
verses.text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for his mercy * and the wonders he does for his children.

half_verses: Let them exalt him in the congregation of the people
and praise him in the council of the elders.
verses.text: Let them exalt him in the congregation of the people * and praise him in the council of the elders.

half_verses: The LORD changed rivers into deserts,
and water-springs into thirsty ground,
verses.text: The LORD changed rivers into deserts, * and water-springs into thirsty ground,

half_verses: A fruitful land into salt flats,
because of the wickedness of those who dwell there.
verses.text: A fruitful land into salt flats, * because of the wickedness of those who dwell there.

half_verses: He changed deserts into pools of water
and dry land into water-springs.
verses.text: He changed deserts into pools of water * and dry land into water-springs.

half_verses: He settled the hungry there,
and they founded a city to dwell in.
verses.text: He settled the hungry there, * and they founded a city to dwell in.

half_verses: They sowed fields, and planted vineyards,
and brought in a fruitful harvest.
verses.text: They sowed fields, and planted vineyards, * and brought in a fruitful harvest.

half_verses: He blessed them, so that they increased greatly;
he did not let their herds decrease.
verses.text: He blessed them, so that they increased greatly; * he did not let their herds decrease.

half_verses: Yet when they were diminished and brought low,
through stress of adversity and sorrow,
verses.text: Yet when they were diminished and brought low, * through stress of adversity and sorrow,

half_verses: (He pours contempt on princes
and makes them wander in trackless wastes)
verses.text: (He pours contempt on princes * and makes them wander in trackless wastes)

half_verses: He lifted up the poor out of misery
and multiplied their families like flocks of sheep.
verses.text: He lifted up the poor out of misery * and multiplied their families like flocks of sheep.

half_verses: The upright will see this and rejoice,
but all wickedness will shut its mouth.
verses.text: The upright will see this and rejoice, * but all wickedness will shut its mouth.

half_verses: Whoever is wise will ponder these things,
and consider well the mercies of the LORD.
verses.text: Whoever is wise will ponder these things, * and consider well the mercies of the LORD.

half_verses: My heart is firmly fixed, O God, my heart is fixed;
I will sing and make melody.
verses.text: My heart is firmly fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; * I will sing and make melody.

half_verses: Wake up, my spirit; awake, lute and harp;
I myself will waken the dawn.
verses.text: Wake up, my spirit; awake, lute and harp; * I myself will waken the dawn.

half_verses: I will confess you among the peoples, O LORD;
I will sing praises to you among the nations.
verses.text: I will confess you among the peoples, O LORD; * I will sing praises to you among the nations.

half_verses: For your loving-kindness is greater than the heavens,
and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
verses.text: For your loving-kindness is greater than the heavens, * and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

half_verses: Exalt yourself above the heavens, O God,
and your glory over all the earth.
verses.text: Exalt yourself above the heavens, O God, * and your glory over all the earth.

half_verses: So that those who are dear to you may be delivered,
save with your right hand and answer me.
verses.text: So that those who are dear to you may be delivered, * save with your right hand and answer me.

half_verses: God spoke from his holy place and said,
"I will exult and parcel out Shechem; I will divide the valley of Succoth.
verses.text: God spoke from his holy place and said, * "I will exult and parcel out Shechem; I will divide the valley of Succoth.

half_verses: Gilead is mine and Manasseh is mine;
Ephraim is my helmet and Judah my scepter.
verses.text: Gilead is mine and Manasseh is mine; * Ephraim is my helmet and Judah my scepter.

half_verses: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I throw down my sandal to claim it,
and over Philistia will I shout in triumph."
verses.text: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I throw down my sandal to claim it, * and over Philistia will I shout in triumph."

half_verses: Who will lead me into the strong city?
who will bring me into Edom?
verses.text: Who will lead me into the strong city? * who will bring me into Edom?

half_verses: Have you not cast us off, O God?
you no longer go out, O God, with our armies.
verses.text: Have you not cast us off, O God? * you no longer go out, O God, with our armies.

half_verses: Grant us your help against the enemy,
for vain is the help of man.
verses.text: Grant us your help against the enemy, * for vain is the help of man.

half_verses: With God we will do valiant deeds,
and he shall tread our enemies under foot.
verses.text: With God we will do valiant deeds, * and he shall tread our enemies under foot.

half_verses: Hold not your tongue, O God of my praise;
for the mouth of the wicked, the mouth of the deceitful, is opened against me.
verses.text: Hold not your tongue, O God of my praise; * for the mouth of the wicked, the mouth of the deceitful, is opened against me.

half_verses: They speak to me with a lying tongue;
they encompass me with hateful words and fight against me without a cause.
verses.text: They speak to me with a lying tongue; * they encompass me with hateful words and fight against me without a cause.

half_verses: Despite my love, they accuse me;
but as for me, I pray for them.
verses.text: Despite my love, they accuse me; * but as for me, I pray for them.

half_verses: They repay evil for good,
and hatred for my love.
verses.text: They repay evil for good, * and hatred for my love.

half_verses: Set a wicked man against him,
and let an accuser stand at his right hand.
verses.text: Set a wicked man against him, * and let an accuser stand at his right hand.

half_verses: When he is judged, let him be found guilty,
and let his appeal be in vain.
verses.text: When he is judged, let him be found guilty, * and let his appeal be in vain.

half_verses: Let his days be few,
and let another take his office.
verses.text: Let his days be few, * and let another take his office.

half_verses: Let his children be fatherless,
and his wife become a widow.
verses.text: Let his children be fatherless, * and his wife become a widow.

half_verses: Let his children be waifs and beggars;
let them be driven from the ruins of their homes.
verses.text: Let his children be waifs and beggars; * let them be driven from the ruins of their homes.

half_verses: Let the creditor seize everything he has;
let strangers plunder his gains.
verses.text: Let the creditor seize everything he has; * let strangers plunder his gains.

half_verses: Let there be no one to show him kindness,
and none to pity his fatherless children.
verses.text: Let there be no one to show him kindness, * and none to pity his fatherless children.

half_verses: Let his descendants be destroyed,
and his name be blotted out in the next generation.
verses.text: Let his descendants be destroyed, * and his name be blotted out in the next generation.

half_verses: Let the wickedness of his fathers be remembered before the LORD,
and his mother's sin not be blotted out;
verses.text: Let the wickedness of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, * and his mother's sin not be blotted out;

half_verses: Let their sin be always before the LORD;
but let him root out their names from the earth;
verses.text: Let their sin be always before the LORD; * but let him root out their names from the earth;

half_verses: Because he did not remember to show mercy,
but persecuted the poor and needy and sought to kill the brokenhearted.
verses.text: Because he did not remember to show mercy, * but persecuted the poor and needy and sought to kill the brokenhearted.

half_verses: He loved cursing, let it come upon him;
he took no delight in blessing, let it depart from him.
verses.text: He loved cursing, let it come upon him; * he took no delight in blessing, let it depart from him.

half_verses: He put on cursing like a garment,
let it soak into his body like water and into his bones like oil;
verses.text: He put on cursing like a garment, * let it soak into his body like water and into his bones like oil;

half_verses: Let it be to him like the cloak which he wraps around himself,
and like the belt that he wears continually.
verses.text: Let it be to him like the cloak which he wraps around himself, * and like the belt that he wears continually.

half_verses: Let this be the recompense from the LORD to my accusers,
and to those who speak evil against me.
verses.text: Let this be the recompense from the LORD to my accusers, * and to those who speak evil against me.

half_verses: But you, O Lord my God, oh, deal with me according to your Name;
for your tender mercy's sake, deliver me.
verses.text: But you, O Lord my God, oh, deal with me according to your Name; * for your tender mercy's sake, deliver me.

half_verses: For I am poor and needy,
and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.text: For I am poor and needy, * and my heart is wounded within me.

half_verses: I have faded away like a shadow when it lengthens;
I am shaken off like a locust.
verses.text: I have faded away like a shadow when it lengthens; * I am shaken off like a locust.

half_verses: My knees are weak through fasting,
and my flesh is wasted and gaunt.
verses.text: My knees are weak through fasting, * and my flesh is wasted and gaunt.

half_verses: I have become a reproach to them;
they see and shake their heads.
verses.text: I have become a reproach to them; * they see and shake their heads.

half_verses: Help me, O LORD my God;
save me for your mercy's sake.
verses.text: Help me, O LORD my God; * save me for your mercy's sake.

half_verses: Let them know that this is your hand,
that you, O LORD, have done it.
verses.text: Let them know that this is your hand, * that you, O LORD, have done it.

half_verses: They may curse, but you will bless;
let those who rise up against me be put to shame, and your servant will rejoice.
verses.text: They may curse, but you will bless; * let those who rise up against me be put to shame, and your servant will rejoice.

half_verses: Let my accusers be clothed with disgrace
and wrap themselves in their shame as in a cloak.
verses.text: Let my accusers be clothed with disgrace * and wrap themselves in their shame as in a cloak.

half_verses: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth;
in the midst of the multitude will I praise him;
verses.text: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth; * in the midst of the multitude will I praise him;

half_verses: Because he stands at the right hand of the needy,
to save his life from those who would condemn him.
verses.text: Because he stands at the right hand of the needy, * to save his life from those who would condemn him.

half_verses: The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand,
until I make your enemies your footstool."
verses.text: The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand, * until I make your enemies your footstool."

half_verses: The LORD will send the scepter of your power out of Zion,
saying, "Rule over your enemies round about you.
verses.text: The LORD will send the scepter of your power out of Zion, * saying, "Rule over your enemies round about you.

half_verses: Princely state has been yours from the day of your birth;
in the beauty of holiness have I begotten you, like dew from the womb of the morning."
verses.text: Princely state has been yours from the day of your birth; * in the beauty of holiness have I begotten you, like dew from the womb of the morning."

half_verses: The LORD has sworn and he will not recant:
"You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek."
verses.text: The LORD has sworn and he will not recant: * "You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek."

half_verses: The Lord who is at your right hand will smite kings in the day of his wrath;
he will rule over the nations.
verses.text: The Lord who is at your right hand will smite kings in the day of his wrath; * he will rule over the nations.

half_verses: He will heap high the corpses;
he will smash heads over the wide earth.
verses.text: He will heap high the corpses; * he will smash heads over the wide earth.

half_verses: He will drink from the brook beside the road;
therefore he will lift high his head.
verses.text: He will drink from the brook beside the road; * therefore he will lift high his head.

half_verses: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart,
in the assembly of the upright, in the congregation.
verses.text: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, * in the assembly of the upright, in the congregation.

half_verses: Great are the deeds of the LORD!
they are studied by all who delight in them.
verses.text: Great are the deeds of the LORD! * they are studied by all who delight in them.

half_verses: His work is full of majesty and splendor,
and his righteousness endures for ever.
verses.text: His work is full of majesty and splendor, * and his righteousness endures for ever.

half_verses: He makes his marvelous works to be remembered;
the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.text: He makes his marvelous works to be remembered; * the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

half_verses: He gives food to those who fear him;
he is ever mindful of his covenant.
verses.text: He gives food to those who fear him; * he is ever mindful of his covenant.

half_verses: He has shown his people the power of his works
in giving them the lands of the nations.
verses.text: He has shown his people the power of his works * in giving them the lands of the nations.

half_verses: The works of his hands are faithfulness and justice;
all his commandments are sure.
verses.text: The works of his hands are faithfulness and justice; * all his commandments are sure.

half_verses: They stand fast for ever and ever,
because they are done in truth and equity.
verses.text: They stand fast for ever and ever, * because they are done in truth and equity.

half_verses: He sent redemption to his people; he commanded his covenant for ever;
holy and awesome is his Name.
verses.text: He sent redemption to his people; he commanded his covenant for ever; * holy and awesome is his Name.

half_verses: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom;
those who act accordingly have a good understanding; his praise endures for ever.
verses.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; * those who act accordingly have a good understanding; his praise endures for ever.

half_verses: Hallelujah! Happy are they who fear the Lord
and have great delight in his commandments!
verses.text: Hallelujah! Happy are they who fear the Lord * and have great delight in his commandments!

half_verses: Their descendants will be mighty in the land;
the generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.text: Their descendants will be mighty in the land; * the generation of the upright will be blessed.

half_verses: Wealth and riches will be in their house,
and their righteousness will last for ever.
verses.text: Wealth and riches will be in their house, * and their righteousness will last for ever.

half_verses: Light shines in the darkness for the upright;
the righteous are merciful and full of compassion.
verses.text: Light shines in the darkness for the upright; * the righteous are merciful and full of compassion.

half_verses: It is good for them to be generous in lending
and to manage their affairs with justice.
verses.text: It is good for them to be generous in lending * and to manage their affairs with justice.

half_verses: For they will never be shaken;
the righteous will be kept in everlasting remembrance.
verses.text: For they will never be shaken; * the righteous will be kept in everlasting remembrance.

half_verses: They will not be afraid of any evil rumors;
their heart is right; they put their trust in the Lord.
verses.text: They will not be afraid of any evil rumors; * their heart is right; they put their trust in the Lord.

half_verses: Their heart is established and will not shrink,
until they see their desire upon their enemies.
verses.text: Their heart is established and will not shrink, * until they see their desire upon their enemies.

half_verses: They have given freely to the poor,
and their righteousness stands fast for ever; they will hold up their head with honor.
verses.text: They have given freely to the poor, * and their righteousness stands fast for ever; they will hold up their head with honor.

half_verses: The wicked will see it and be angry; they will gnash their teeth and pine away;
the desires of the wicked will perish.
verses.text: The wicked will see it and be angry; they will gnash their teeth and pine away; * the desires of the wicked will perish.

half_verses: Hallelujah! Give praise, you servants of the LORD;
praise the Name of the LORD.
verses.text: Hallelujah! Give praise, you servants of the LORD; * praise the Name of the LORD.

half_verses: Let the Name of the LORD be blessed,
from this time forth for evermore.
verses.text: Let the Name of the LORD be blessed, * from this time forth for evermore.

half_verses: From the rising of the sun to its going down
let the Name of the LORD be praised.
verses.text: From the rising of the sun to its going down * let the Name of the LORD be praised.

half_verses: The LORD is high above all nations,
and his glory above the heavens.
verses.text: The LORD is high above all nations, * and his glory above the heavens.

half_verses: Who is like the LORD our God, who sits enthroned on high,
but stoops to behold the heavens and the earth?
verses.text: Who is like the LORD our God, who sits enthroned on high, * but stoops to behold the heavens and the earth?

half_verses: He takes up the weak out of the dust
and lifts up the poor from the ashes.
verses.text: He takes up the weak out of the dust * and lifts up the poor from the ashes.

half_verses: He sets them with the princes,
with the princes of his people.
verses.text: He sets them with the princes, * with the princes of his people.

half_verses: He makes the woman of a childless house
to be a joyful mother of children.
verses.text: He makes the woman of a childless house * to be a joyful mother of children.

half_verses: Hallelujah! When Israel came out of Egypt,
the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech,
verses.text: Hallelujah! When Israel came out of Egypt, * the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech,

half_verses: Judah became God's sanctuary
and Israel his dominion.
verses.text: Judah became God's sanctuary * and Israel his dominion.

half_verses: The sea beheld it and fled;
Jordan turned and went back.
verses.text: The sea beheld it and fled; * Jordan turned and went back.

half_verses: The mountains skipped like rams,
and the little hills like young sheep.
verses.text: The mountains skipped like rams, * and the little hills like young sheep.

half_verses: What ailed you, O sea, that you fled?
O Jordan, that you turned back?
verses.text: What ailed you, O sea, that you fled? * O Jordan, that you turned back?

half_verses: You mountains, that you skipped like rams?
you little hills like young sheep?
verses.text: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? * you little hills like young sheep?

half_verses: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord,
at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.text: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, * at the presence of the God of Jacob,

half_verses: Who turned the hard rock into a pool of water
and flint-stone into a flowing spring.
verses.text: Who turned the hard rock into a pool of water * and flint-stone into a flowing spring.

half_verses: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to your Name give glory;
because of your love and because of your faithfulness.
verses.text: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to your Name give glory; * because of your love and because of your faithfulness.

half_verses: Why should the heathen say,
"Where then is their God?"
verses.text: Why should the heathen say, * "Where then is their God?"

half_verses: Our God is in heaven;
whatever he wills to do he does.
verses.text: Our God is in heaven; * whatever he wills to do he does.

half_verses: Their idols are silver and gold,
the work of human hands.
verses.text: Their idols are silver and gold, * the work of human hands.

half_verses: They have mouths, but they cannot speak;
eyes have they, but they cannot see;
verses.text: They have mouths, but they cannot speak; * eyes have they, but they cannot see;

half_verses: They have ears but they cannot hear;
noses, but they cannot smell;
verses.text: They have ears but they cannot hear; * noses, but they cannot smell;

half_verses: They have hands, but they cannot feel; feet, but they cannot walk;
they make no sound with their throat.
verses.text: They have hands, but they cannot feel; feet, but they cannot walk; * they make no sound with their throat.

half_verses: Those who make them are like them,
and so are all who put their trust in them.
verses.text: Those who make them are like them, * and so are all who put their trust in them.

half_verses: O Israel, trust in the LORD;
he is their help and their shield.
verses.text: O Israel, trust in the LORD; * he is their help and their shield.

half_verses: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD;
he is their help and their shield.
verses.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD; * he is their help and their shield.

half_verses: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD;
he is their help and their shield.
verses.text: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; * he is their help and their shield.

half_verses: The LORD has been mindful of us, and he will bless us;
he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron;
verses.text: The LORD has been mindful of us, and he will bless us; * he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron;
