half_verses: He will bless those who fear the LORD,
both small and great together.
verses.text: He will bless those who fear the LORD, * both small and great together.

half_verses: May the LORD increase you more and more,
you and your children after you.
verses.text: May the LORD increase you more and more, * you and your children after you.

half_verses: May you be blessed by the LORD,
the maker of heaven and earth.
verses.text: May you be blessed by the LORD, * the maker of heaven and earth.

half_verses: The heaven of heavens is the LORD'S,
but he entrusted the earth to its peoples.
verses.text: The heaven of heavens is the LORD'S, * but he entrusted the earth to its peoples.

half_verses: The dead do not praise the LORD,
nor all those who go down into silence;
verses.text: The dead do not praise the LORD, * nor all those who go down into silence;

half_verses: But we will bless the LORD,
from this time forth for evermore. Hallelujah!
verses.text: But we will bless the LORD, * from this time forth for evermore. Hallelujah!

half_verses: I love the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my supplication,
because he has inclined his ear to me whenever I called upon him.
verses.text: I love the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my supplication, * because he has inclined his ear to me whenever I called upon him.

half_verses: The cords of death entangled me; the grip of the grave took hold of me;
I came to grief and sorrow.
verses.text: The cords of death entangled me; the grip of the grave took hold of me; * I came to grief and sorrow.

half_verses: Then I called upon the Name of the LORD:
"O LORD, I pray you, save my life."
verses.text: Then I called upon the Name of the LORD: * "O LORD, I pray you, save my life."

half_verses: Gracious is the LORD and righteous;
our God is full of compassion.
verses.text: Gracious is the LORD and righteous; * our God is full of compassion.

half_verses: The LORD watches over the innocent;
I was brought very low, and he helped me.
verses.text: The LORD watches over the innocent; * I was brought very low, and he helped me.

half_verses: Turn again to your rest, O my soul,
for the LORD has treated you well.
verses.text: Turn again to your rest, O my soul, * for the LORD has treated you well.

half_verses: For you have rescued my life from death,
my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.
verses.text: For you have rescued my life from death, * my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.

half_verses: I will walk in the presence of the LORD
in the land of the living.
verses.text: I will walk in the presence of the LORD * in the land of the living.

half_verses: I believed, even when I said, "I have been brought very low."
In my distress I said, "No one can be trusted."
verses.text: I believed, even when I said, "I have been brought very low." * In my distress I said, "No one can be trusted."

half_verses: How shall I repay the LORD
for all the good things he has done for me?
verses.text: How shall I repay the LORD * for all the good things he has done for me?

half_verses: I will lift up the cup of salvation
and call upon the Name of the LORD.
verses.text: I will lift up the cup of salvation * and call upon the Name of the LORD.

half_verses: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD
in the presence of all his people.
verses.text: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD * in the presence of all his people.

half_verses: Precious in the sight of the LORD
is the death of his servants.
verses.text: Precious in the sight of the LORD * is the death of his servants.

half_verses: O LORD, I am your servant;
I am your servant and the child of your handmaid; you have freed me from my bonds.
verses.text: O LORD, I am your servant; * I am your servant and the child of your handmaid; you have freed me from my bonds.

half_verses: I will offer you the sacrifice of thanksgiving
and call upon the Name of the LORD.
verses.text: I will offer you the sacrifice of thanksgiving * and call upon the Name of the LORD.

half_verses: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD
in the presence of all his people,
verses.text: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD * in the presence of all his people,

half_verses: In the courts of the LORD'S house,
in the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
verses.text: In the courts of the LORD'S house, * in the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

half_verses: Praise the LORD, all you nations;
laud him, all you peoples.
verses.text: Praise the LORD, all you nations; * laud him, all you peoples.

half_verses: For his loving-kindness toward us is great,
and the faithfulness of the LORD endures for ever. Hallelujah!
verses.text: For his loving-kindness toward us is great, * and the faithfulness of the LORD endures for ever. Hallelujah!

half_verses: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good;
his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; * his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Let Israel now proclaim,
"His mercy endures for ever."
verses.text: Let Israel now proclaim, * "His mercy endures for ever."

half_verses: Let the house of Aaron now proclaim,
"His mercy endures for ever."
verses.text: Let the house of Aaron now proclaim, * "His mercy endures for ever."

half_verses: Let those who fear the LORD now proclaim,
"His mercy endures for ever."
verses.text: Let those who fear the LORD now proclaim, * "His mercy endures for ever."

half_verses: I called to the LORD in my distress;
the LORD answered by setting me free.
verses.text: I called to the LORD in my distress; * the LORD answered by setting me free.

half_verses: The LORD is at my side, therefore I will not fear;
what can anyone do to me?
verses.text: The LORD is at my side, therefore I will not fear; * what can anyone do to me?

half_verses: The LORD is at my side to help me;
I will triumph over those who hate me.
verses.text: The LORD is at my side to help me; * I will triumph over those who hate me.

half_verses: It is better to rely on the LORD
than to put any trust in flesh.
verses.text: It is better to rely on the LORD * than to put any trust in flesh.

half_verses: It is better to rely on the LORD
than to put any trust in rulers.
verses.text: It is better to rely on the LORD * than to put any trust in rulers.

half_verses: All the ungodly encompass me;
in the Name of the LORD I will repel them.
verses.text: All the ungodly encompass me; * in the Name of the LORD I will repel them.

half_verses: They hem me in, they hem me in on every side;
in the name of the LORD I will repel them.
verses.text: They hem me in, they hem me in on every side; * in the name of the LORD I will repel them.

half_verses: They swarm about me like bees; they blaze like a fire of thorns;
in the name of the LORD I will repel them.
verses.text: They swarm about me like bees; they blaze like a fire of thorns; * in the name of the LORD I will repel them.

half_verses: I was pressed so hard that I almost fell,
but the LORD came to my help.
verses.text: I was pressed so hard that I almost fell, * but the LORD came to my help.

half_verses: The LORD is my strength and my song,
and he has become my salvation.
verses.text: The LORD is my strength and my song, * and he has become my salvation.

half_verses: There is a sound of exultation and victory
in the tents of the righteous:
verses.text: There is a sound of exultation and victory * in the tents of the righteous:

half_verses: "The right hand of the LORD has triumphed!
the right hand of the LORD is exalted! the right hand of the LORD has triumphed!"
verses.text: "The right hand of the LORD has triumphed! * the right hand of the LORD is exalted! the right hand of the LORD has triumphed!"

half_verses: I shall not die, but live,
and declare the works of the LORD.
verses.text: I shall not die, but live, * and declare the works of the LORD.

half_verses: The LORD has punished me sorely,
but he did not hand me over to death.
verses.text: The LORD has punished me sorely, * but he did not hand me over to death.

half_verses: Open for me the gates of righteousness;
I will enter them; I will offer thanks to the LORD.
verses.text: Open for me the gates of righteousness; * I will enter them; I will offer thanks to the LORD.

half_verses: "This is the gate of the LORD;
he who is righteous may enter."
verses.text: "This is the gate of the LORD; * he who is righteous may enter."

half_verses: I will give thanks to you, for you answered me
and have become my salvation.
verses.text: I will give thanks to you, for you answered me * and have become my salvation.

half_verses: The same stone which the builders rejected
has become the chief cornerstone.
verses.text: The same stone which the builders rejected * has become the chief cornerstone.

half_verses: This is the LORD'S doing,
and it is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.text: This is the LORD'S doing, * and it is marvelous in our eyes.

half_verses: On this day the LORD has acted;
we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.text: On this day the LORD has acted; * we will rejoice and be glad in it.

half_verses: Hosanna, LORD, hosanna!
LORD, send us now success.
verses.text: Hosanna, LORD, hosanna! * LORD, send us now success.

half_verses: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord;
we bless you from the house of the LORD.
verses.text: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord; * we bless you from the house of the LORD.

half_verses: God is the LORD; he has shined upon us;
form a procession with branches up to the horns of the altar.
verses.text: God is the LORD; he has shined upon us; * form a procession with branches up to the horns of the altar.

half_verses: "You are my God, and I will thank you;
you are my God, and I will exalt you."
verses.text: "You are my God, and I will thank you; * you are my God, and I will exalt you."

half_verses: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good;
his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; * his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Happy are they whose way is blameless,
who walk in the law of the LORD!
verses.text: Happy are they whose way is blameless, * who walk in the law of the LORD!

half_verses: Happy are they who observe his decrees
and seek him with all their hearts!
verses.text: Happy are they who observe his decrees * and seek him with all their hearts!

half_verses: Who never do any wrong,
but always walk in his ways.
verses.text: Who never do any wrong, * but always walk in his ways.

half_verses: You laid down your commandments,
that we should fully keep them.
verses.text: You laid down your commandments, * that we should fully keep them.

half_verses: Oh, that my ways were made so direct
that I might keep your statutes!
verses.text: Oh, that my ways were made so direct * that I might keep your statutes!

half_verses: Then I should not be put to shame,
when I regard all your commandments.
verses.text: Then I should not be put to shame, * when I regard all your commandments.

half_verses: I will thank you with an unfeigned heart,
when I have learned your righteous judgments.
verses.text: I will thank you with an unfeigned heart, * when I have learned your righteous judgments.

half_verses: I will keep your statutes;
do not utterly forsake me.
verses.text: I will keep your statutes; * do not utterly forsake me.

half_verses: How shall a young man cleanse his way?
By keeping to your words.
verses.text: How shall a young man cleanse his way? * By keeping to your words.

half_verses: With my whole heart I seek you;
let me not stray from your commandments.
verses.text: With my whole heart I seek you; * let me not stray from your commandments.

half_verses: I treasure your promise in my heart,
that I may not sin against you.
verses.text: I treasure your promise in my heart, * that I may not sin against you.

half_verses: Blessed are you, O LORD;
instruct me in your statutes.
verses.text: Blessed are you, O LORD; * instruct me in your statutes.

half_verses: With my lips will I recite
all the judgments of your mouth.
verses.text: With my lips will I recite * all the judgments of your mouth.

half_verses: I have taken greater delight in the way of your decrees
than in all manner of riches.
verses.text: I have taken greater delight in the way of your decrees * than in all manner of riches.

half_verses: I will meditate on your commandments
and give attention to your ways.
verses.text: I will meditate on your commandments * and give attention to your ways.

half_verses: My delight is in your statutes;
I will not forget your word.
verses.text: My delight is in your statutes; * I will not forget your word.

half_verses: Deal bountifully with your servant,
that I may live and keep your word.
verses.text: Deal bountifully with your servant, * that I may live and keep your word.

half_verses: Open my eyes, that I may see
the wonders of your law.
verses.text: Open my eyes, that I may see * the wonders of your law.

half_verses: I am a stranger here on earth;
do not hide your commandments from me.
verses.text: I am a stranger here on earth; * do not hide your commandments from me.

half_verses: My soul is consumed at all times
with longing for your judgments.
verses.text: My soul is consumed at all times * with longing for your judgments.

half_verses: You have rebuked the insolent;
cursed are they who stray from your commandments!
verses.text: You have rebuked the insolent; * cursed are they who stray from your commandments!

half_verses: Turn from me shame and rebuke,
for I have kept your decrees.
verses.text: Turn from me shame and rebuke, * for I have kept your decrees.

half_verses: Even though rulers sit and plot against me,
I will meditate on your statutes.
verses.text: Even though rulers sit and plot against me, * I will meditate on your statutes.

half_verses: For your decrees are my delight,
and they are my counselors.
verses.text: For your decrees are my delight, * and they are my counselors.

half_verses: My soul cleaves to the dust;
give me life according to your word.
verses.text: My soul cleaves to the dust; * give me life according to your word.

half_verses: I have confessed my ways, and you answered me;
instruct me in your statutes.
verses.text: I have confessed my ways, and you answered me; * instruct me in your statutes.

half_verses: Make me understand the way of your commandments,
that I may meditate on your marvelous works.
verses.text: Make me understand the way of your commandments, * that I may meditate on your marvelous works.

half_verses: My soul melts away for sorrow;
strengthen me according to your word.
verses.text: My soul melts away for sorrow; * strengthen me according to your word.

half_verses: Take from me the way of lying;
let me find grace through your law.
verses.text: Take from me the way of lying; * let me find grace through your law.

half_verses: I have chosen the way of faithfulness;
I have set your judgments before me.
verses.text: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; * I have set your judgments before me.

half_verses: I hold fast to your decrees;
O LORD, let me not be put to shame.
verses.text: I hold fast to your decrees; * O LORD, let me not be put to shame.

half_verses: I will run the way of your commandments,
for you have set my heart at liberty.
verses.text: I will run the way of your commandments, * for you have set my heart at liberty.

half_verses: Teach me, O LORD, the way of your statutes,
and I shall keep it to the end.
verses.text: Teach me, O LORD, the way of your statutes, * and I shall keep it to the end.

half_verses: Give me understanding, and I shall keep your law;
I shall keep it with all my heart.
verses.text: Give me understanding, and I shall keep your law; * I shall keep it with all my heart.

half_verses: Make me go in the path of your commandments,
for that is my desire.
verses.text: Make me go in the path of your commandments, * for that is my desire.

half_verses: Incline my heart to your decrees
and not to unjust gain.
verses.text: Incline my heart to your decrees * and not to unjust gain.

half_verses: Turn my eyes from watching what is worthless;
give me life in your ways.
verses.text: Turn my eyes from watching what is worthless; * give me life in your ways.

half_verses: Fulfill your promise to your servant,
which you make to those who fear you.
verses.text: Fulfill your promise to your servant, * which you make to those who fear you.

half_verses: Turn away the reproach which I dread,
because your judgments are good.
verses.text: Turn away the reproach which I dread, * because your judgments are good.

half_verses: Behold, I long for your commandments;
in your righteousness preserve my life.
verses.text: Behold, I long for your commandments; * in your righteousness preserve my life.

half_verses: Let your loving-kindness come to me, O LORD,
and your salvation, according to your promise.
verses.text: Let your loving-kindness come to me, O LORD, * and your salvation, according to your promise.

half_verses: Then shall I have a word for those who taunt me,
because I trust in your words.
verses.text: Then shall I have a word for those who taunt me, * because I trust in your words.

half_verses: Do not take the word of truth out of my mouth,
for my hope is in your judgments.
verses.text: Do not take the word of truth out of my mouth, * for my hope is in your judgments.

half_verses: I shall continue to keep your law;
I shall keep it for ever and ever.
verses.text: I shall continue to keep your law; * I shall keep it for ever and ever.

half_verses: I will walk at liberty,
because I study your commandments.
verses.text: I will walk at liberty, * because I study your commandments.

half_verses: I will tell of your decrees before kings
and will not be ashamed.
verses.text: I will tell of your decrees before kings * and will not be ashamed.

half_verses: I delight in your commandments,
which I have always loved.
verses.text: I delight in your commandments, * which I have always loved.

half_verses: I will lift up my hands to your commandments,
and I will meditate on your statutes.
verses.text: I will lift up my hands to your commandments, * and I will meditate on your statutes.

half_verses: Remember your word to your servant,
because you have given me hope.
verses.text: Remember your word to your servant, * because you have given me hope.

half_verses: This is my comfort in my trouble,
that your promise gives me life.
verses.text: This is my comfort in my trouble, * that your promise gives me life.

half_verses: The proud have derided me cruelly,
but I have not turned from your law.
verses.text: The proud have derided me cruelly, * but I have not turned from your law.

half_verses: When I remember your judgments of old,
O LORD, I take great comfort.
verses.text: When I remember your judgments of old, * O LORD, I take great comfort.

half_verses: I am filled with a burning rage,
because of the wicked who forsake your law.
verses.text: I am filled with a burning rage, * because of the wicked who forsake your law.

half_verses: Your statutes have been like songs to me
wherever I have lived as a stranger.
verses.text: Your statutes have been like songs to me * wherever I have lived as a stranger.

half_verses: I remember your Name in the night, O LORD,
and dwell upon your law.
verses.text: I remember your Name in the night, O LORD, * and dwell upon your law.

half_verses: This is how it has been with me,
because I have kept your commandments.
verses.text: This is how it has been with me, * because I have kept your commandments.

half_verses: You only are my portion, O LORD;
I have promised to keep your words.
verses.text: You only are my portion, O LORD; * I have promised to keep your words.

half_verses: I entreat you with all my heart,
be merciful to me according to your promise.
verses.text: I entreat you with all my heart, * be merciful to me according to your promise.

half_verses: I have considered my ways
and turned my feet toward your decrees.
verses.text: I have considered my ways * and turned my feet toward your decrees.

half_verses: I hasten and do not tarry
to keep your commandments.
verses.text: I hasten and do not tarry * to keep your commandments.

half_verses: Though the cords of the wicked entangle me,
I do not forget your law.
verses.text: Though the cords of the wicked entangle me, * I do not forget your law.

half_verses: At midnight I will rise to give you thanks,
because of your righteous judgments.
verses.text: At midnight I will rise to give you thanks, * because of your righteous judgments.

half_verses: I am a companion of all who fear you
and of those who keep your commandments.
verses.text: I am a companion of all who fear you * and of those who keep your commandments.

half_verses: The earth, O LORD, is full of your love;
instruct me in your statutes.
verses.text: The earth, O LORD, is full of your love; * instruct me in your statutes.

half_verses: O LORD, you have dealt graciously with your servant,
according to your word.
verses.text: O LORD, you have dealt graciously with your servant, * according to your word.

half_verses: Teach me discernment and knowledge,
for I have believed in your commandments.
verses.text: Teach me discernment and knowledge, * for I have believed in your commandments.

half_verses: Before I was afflicted I went astray,
but now I keep your word.
verses.text: Before I was afflicted I went astray, * but now I keep your word.

half_verses: You are good and you bring forth good;
instruct me in your statutes.
verses.text: You are good and you bring forth good; * instruct me in your statutes.

half_verses: The proud have smeared me with lies,
but I will keep your commandments with my whole heart.
verses.text: The proud have smeared me with lies, * but I will keep your commandments with my whole heart.

half_verses: Their heart is gross and fat,
but my delight is in your law.
verses.text: Their heart is gross and fat, * but my delight is in your law.

half_verses: It is good for me that I have been afflicted,
that I might learn your statutes.
verses.text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, * that I might learn your statutes.

half_verses: The law of your mouth is dearer to me
than thousands in gold and silver.
verses.text: The law of your mouth is dearer to me * than thousands in gold and silver.

half_verses: Your hands have made me and fashioned me;
give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
verses.text: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; * give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

half_verses: Those who fear you will be glad when they see me,
because I trust in your word.
verses.text: Those who fear you will be glad when they see me, * because I trust in your word.

half_verses: I know, O LORD, that your judgments are right
and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.text: I know, O LORD, that your judgments are right * and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

half_verses: Let your loving-kindness be my comfort,
as you have promised to your servant.
verses.text: Let your loving-kindness be my comfort, * as you have promised to your servant.

half_verses: Let your compassion come to me, that I may live,
for your law is my delight.
verses.text: Let your compassion come to me, that I may live, * for your law is my delight.

half_verses: Let the arrogant be put to shame, for they wrong me with lies;
but I will meditate on your commandments.
verses.text: Let the arrogant be put to shame, for they wrong me with lies; * but I will meditate on your commandments.

half_verses: Let those who fear you turn to me,
and also those who know your decrees.
verses.text: Let those who fear you turn to me, * and also those who know your decrees.

half_verses: Let my heart be sound in your statutes,
that I may not be put to shame.
verses.text: Let my heart be sound in your statutes, * that I may not be put to shame.

half_verses: My soul has longed for your salvation;
I have put my hope in your word.
verses.text: My soul has longed for your salvation; * I have put my hope in your word.

half_verses: My eyes have failed from watching for your promise,
and I say, "When will you comfort me?"
verses.text: My eyes have failed from watching for your promise, * and I say, "When will you comfort me?"

half_verses: I have become like a leather flask in the smoke,
but I have not forgotten your statutes.
verses.text: I have become like a leather flask in the smoke, * but I have not forgotten your statutes.

half_verses: How much longer must I wait?
when will you give judgment against those who persecute me?
verses.text: How much longer must I wait? * when will you give judgment against those who persecute me?

half_verses: The proud have dug pits for me;
they do not keep your law.
verses.text: The proud have dug pits for me; * they do not keep your law.

half_verses: All your commandments are true;
help me, for they persecute me with lies.
verses.text: All your commandments are true; * help me, for they persecute me with lies.

half_verses: They had almost made an end of me on earth,
but I have not forsaken your commandments.
verses.text: They had almost made an end of me on earth, * but I have not forsaken your commandments.

half_verses: In your loving-kindness, revive me,
that I may keep the decrees of your mouth.
verses.text: In your loving-kindness, revive me, * that I may keep the decrees of your mouth.

half_verses: O LORD, your word is everlasting;
it stands firm in the heavens.
verses.text: O LORD, your word is everlasting; * it stands firm in the heavens.

half_verses: Your faithfulness remains from one generation to another;
you established the earth, and it abides.
verses.text: Your faithfulness remains from one generation to another; * you established the earth, and it abides.

half_verses: By your decree these continue to this day,
for all things are your servants.
verses.text: By your decree these continue to this day, * for all things are your servants.

half_verses: If my delight had not been in your law,
I should have perished in my affliction.
verses.text: If my delight had not been in your law, * I should have perished in my affliction.

half_verses: I will never forget your commandments,
because by them you give me life.
verses.text: I will never forget your commandments, * because by them you give me life.

half_verses: I am yours; oh, that you would save me!
for I study your commandments.
verses.text: I am yours; oh, that you would save me! * for I study your commandments.

half_verses: Though the wicked lie in wait for me to destroy me,
I will apply my mind to your decrees.
verses.text: Though the wicked lie in wait for me to destroy me, * I will apply my mind to your decrees.

half_verses: I see that all things come to an end,
but your commandment has no bounds.
verses.text: I see that all things come to an end, * but your commandment has no bounds.

half_verses: Oh, how I love your law!
all the day long it is in my mind.
verses.text: Oh, how I love your law! * all the day long it is in my mind.

half_verses: Your commandment has made me wiser than my enemies,
and it is always with me.
verses.text: Your commandment has made me wiser than my enemies, * and it is always with me.

half_verses: I have more understanding than all my teachers,
for your decrees are my study.
verses.text: I have more understanding than all my teachers, * for your decrees are my study.

half_verses: I am wiser than the elders,
because I observe your commandments.
verses.text: I am wiser than the elders, * because I observe your commandments.

half_verses: I restrain my feet from every evil way,
that I may keep your word.
verses.text: I restrain my feet from every evil way, * that I may keep your word.

half_verses: I do not shrink from your judgments,
because you yourself have taught me.
verses.text: I do not shrink from your judgments, * because you yourself have taught me.

half_verses: How sweet are your words to my taste!
they are sweeter than honey to my mouth.
verses.text: How sweet are your words to my taste! * they are sweeter than honey to my mouth.

half_verses: Through your commandments I gain understanding;
therefore I hate every lying way.
verses.text: Through your commandments I gain understanding; * therefore I hate every lying way.

half_verses: Your word is a lantern to my feet
and a light upon my path.
verses.text: Your word is a lantern to my feet * and a light upon my path.

half_verses: I have sworn and am determined
to keep your righteous judgments.
verses.text: I have sworn and am determined * to keep your righteous judgments.

half_verses: I am deeply troubled;
preserve my life, O LORD, according to your word.
verses.text: I am deeply troubled; * preserve my life, O LORD, according to your word.

half_verses: Accept, O LORD, the willing tribute of my lips,
and teach me your judgments.
verses.text: Accept, O LORD, the willing tribute of my lips, * and teach me your judgments.

half_verses: My life is always in my hand,
yet I do not forget your law.
verses.text: My life is always in my hand, * yet I do not forget your law.

half_verses: The wicked have set a trap for me,
but I have not strayed from your commandments.
verses.text: The wicked have set a trap for me, * but I have not strayed from your commandments.

half_verses: Your decrees are my inheritance for ever;
truly, they are the joy of my heart.
verses.text: Your decrees are my inheritance for ever; * truly, they are the joy of my heart.

half_verses: I have applied my heart to fulfill your statutes
for ever and to the end.
verses.text: I have applied my heart to fulfill your statutes * for ever and to the end.

half_verses: I hate those who have a divided heart,
but your law do I love.
verses.text: I hate those who have a divided heart, * but your law do I love.

half_verses: You are my refuge and shield;
my hope is in your word.
verses.text: You are my refuge and shield; * my hope is in your word.

half_verses: Away from me, you wicked!
I will keep the commandments of my God.
verses.text: Away from me, you wicked! * I will keep the commandments of my God.

half_verses: Sustain me according to your promise, that I may live,
and let me not be disappointed in my hope.
verses.text: Sustain me according to your promise, that I may live, * and let me not be disappointed in my hope.

half_verses: Hold me up, and I shall be safe,
and my delight shall be ever in your statutes.
verses.text: Hold me up, and I shall be safe, * and my delight shall be ever in your statutes.

half_verses: You spurn all who stray from your statutes;
their deceitfulness is in vain.
verses.text: You spurn all who stray from your statutes; * their deceitfulness is in vain.

half_verses: In your sight all the wicked of the earth are but dross;
therefore I love your decrees.
verses.text: In your sight all the wicked of the earth are but dross; * therefore I love your decrees.

half_verses: My flesh trembles with dread of you;
I am afraid of your judgments.
verses.text: My flesh trembles with dread of you; * I am afraid of your judgments.

half_verses: I have done what is just and right;
do not deliver me to my oppressors.
verses.text: I have done what is just and right; * do not deliver me to my oppressors.

half_verses: Be surety for your servant's good;
let not the proud oppress me.
verses.text: Be surety for your servant's good; * let not the proud oppress me.

half_verses: My eyes have failed from watching for your salvation
and for your righteous promise.
verses.text: My eyes have failed from watching for your salvation * and for your righteous promise.

half_verses: Deal with your servant according to your loving-kindness
and teach me your statutes.
verses.text: Deal with your servant according to your loving-kindness * and teach me your statutes.

half_verses: I am your servant; grant me understanding,
that I may know your decrees.
verses.text: I am your servant; grant me understanding, * that I may know your decrees.

half_verses: It is time for you to act, O LORD,
for they have broken your law.
verses.text: It is time for you to act, O LORD, * for they have broken your law.

half_verses: Truly, I love your commandments
more than gold and precious stones.
verses.text: Truly, I love your commandments * more than gold and precious stones.

half_verses: I hold all your commandments to be right for me;
all paths of falsehood I abhor.
verses.text: I hold all your commandments to be right for me; * all paths of falsehood I abhor.

half_verses: Your decrees are wonderful;
therefore I obey them with all my heart.
verses.text: Your decrees are wonderful; * therefore I obey them with all my heart.

half_verses: When your word goes forth it gives light;
it gives understanding to the simple.
verses.text: When your word goes forth it gives light; * it gives understanding to the simple.

half_verses: I open my mouth and pant;
I long for your commandments.
verses.text: I open my mouth and pant; * I long for your commandments.

half_verses: Turn to me in mercy,
as you always do to those who love your Name.
verses.text: Turn to me in mercy, * as you always do to those who love your Name.

half_verses: Steady my footsteps in your word;
let no iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.text: Steady my footsteps in your word; * let no iniquity have dominion over me.

half_verses: Rescue me from those who oppress me,
and I will keep your commandments.
verses.text: Rescue me from those who oppress me, * and I will keep your commandments.

half_verses: Let your countenance shine upon your servant
and teach me your statutes.
verses.text: Let your countenance shine upon your servant * and teach me your statutes.

half_verses: My eyes shed streams of tears,
because people do not keep your law.
verses.text: My eyes shed streams of tears, * because people do not keep your law.

half_verses: You are righteous, O LORD,
and upright are your judgments.
verses.text: You are righteous, O LORD, * and upright are your judgments.

half_verses: You have issued your decrees
with justice and in perfect faithfulness.
verses.text: You have issued your decrees * with justice and in perfect faithfulness.

half_verses: My indignation has consumed me,
because my enemies forget your words.
verses.text: My indignation has consumed me, * because my enemies forget your words.

half_verses: Your word has been tested to the uttermost,
and your servant holds it dear.
verses.text: Your word has been tested to the uttermost, * and your servant holds it dear.

half_verses: I am small and of little account,
yet I do not forget your commandments.
verses.text: I am small and of little account, * yet I do not forget your commandments.

half_verses: Your justice is an everlasting justice
and your law is the truth.
verses.text: Your justice is an everlasting justice * and your law is the truth.

half_verses: Trouble and distress have come upon me,
yet your commandments are my delight.
verses.text: Trouble and distress have come upon me, * yet your commandments are my delight.

half_verses: The righteousness of your decrees is everlasting;
grant me understanding, that I may live.
verses.text: The righteousness of your decrees is everlasting; * grant me understanding, that I may live.

half_verses: I call with my whole heart;
answer me, O LORD, that I may keep your statutes.
verses.text: I call with my whole heart; * answer me, O LORD, that I may keep your statutes.

half_verses: I call to you; oh, that you would save me!
I will keep your decrees.
verses.text: I call to you; oh, that you would save me! * I will keep your decrees.

half_verses: Early in the morning I cry out to you,
for in your word is my trust.
verses.text: Early in the morning I cry out to you, * for in your word is my trust.

half_verses: My eyes are open in the night watches,
that I may meditate upon your promise.
verses.text: My eyes are open in the night watches, * that I may meditate upon your promise.

half_verses: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to your loving-kindness;
according to your judgments, give me life.
verses.text: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to your loving-kindness; * according to your judgments, give me life.

half_verses: They draw near who in malice persecute me;
they are very far from your law.
verses.text: They draw near who in malice persecute me; * they are very far from your law.

half_verses: You, O LORD, are near at hand,
and all your commandments are true.
verses.text: You, O LORD, are near at hand, * and all your commandments are true.

half_verses: Long have I known from your decrees
that you have established them for ever.
verses.text: Long have I known from your decrees * that you have established them for ever.

half_verses: Behold my affliction and deliver me,
for I do not forget your law.
verses.text: Behold my affliction and deliver me, * for I do not forget your law.

half_verses: Plead my cause and redeem me;
according to your promise, give me life.
verses.text: Plead my cause and redeem me; * according to your promise, give me life.

half_verses: Deliverance is far from the wicked,
for they do not study your statutes.
verses.text: Deliverance is far from the wicked, * for they do not study your statutes.

half_verses: Great is your compassion, O LORD;
preserve my life, according to your judgments.
verses.text: Great is your compassion, O LORD; * preserve my life, according to your judgments.

half_verses: There are many who persecute and oppress me,
yet I have not swerved from your decrees.
verses.text: There are many who persecute and oppress me, * yet I have not swerved from your decrees.

half_verses: I look with loathing at the faithless,
for they have not kept your word.
verses.text: I look with loathing at the faithless, * for they have not kept your word.

half_verses: See how I love your commandments!
O LORD, in your mercy, preserve me.
verses.text: See how I love your commandments! * O LORD, in your mercy, preserve me.

half_verses: The heart of your word is truth;
all your righteous judgments endure for evermore.
verses.text: The heart of your word is truth; * all your righteous judgments endure for evermore.

half_verses: Rulers have persecuted me without a cause,
but my heart stands in awe of your word.
verses.text: Rulers have persecuted me without a cause, * but my heart stands in awe of your word.

half_verses: I am as glad because of your promise
as one who finds great spoils.
verses.text: I am as glad because of your promise * as one who finds great spoils.

half_verses: As for lies, I hate and abhor them,
but your law is my love.
verses.text: As for lies, I hate and abhor them, * but your law is my love.

half_verses: Seven times a day do I praise you,
because of your righteous judgments.
verses.text: Seven times a day do I praise you, * because of your righteous judgments.

half_verses: Great peace have they who love your law;
for them there is no stumbling block.
verses.text: Great peace have they who love your law; * for them there is no stumbling block.

half_verses: I have hoped for your salvation, O LORD,
and have fulfilled your commandments.
verses.text: I have hoped for your salvation, O LORD, * and have fulfilled your commandments.

half_verses: I have kept your decrees
and I have loved them deeply.
verses.text: I have kept your decrees * and I have loved them deeply.

half_verses: I have kept your commandments and decrees,
for all my ways are before you.
verses.text: I have kept your commandments and decrees, * for all my ways are before you.

half_verses: Let my cry come before you, O LORD;
give me understanding, according to your word.
verses.text: Let my cry come before you, O LORD; * give me understanding, according to your word.

half_verses: Let my supplication come before you;
deliver me, according to your promise.
verses.text: Let my supplication come before you; * deliver me, according to your promise.

half_verses: My lips shall pour forth your praise,
when you teach me your statutes.
verses.text: My lips shall pour forth your praise, * when you teach me your statutes.

half_verses: My tongue shall sing of your promise,
for all your commandments are righteous.
verses.text: My tongue shall sing of your promise, * for all your commandments are righteous.

half_verses: Let your hand be ready to help me,
for I have chosen your commandments.
verses.text: Let your hand be ready to help me, * for I have chosen your commandments.

half_verses: I long for your salvation, O LORD,
and your law is my delight.
verses.text: I long for your salvation, O LORD, * and your law is my delight.

half_verses: Let me live, and I will praise you,
and let your judgments help me.
verses.text: Let me live, and I will praise you, * and let your judgments help me.

half_verses: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost;
search for your servant, for I do not forget your commandments.
verses.text: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost; * search for your servant, for I do not forget your commandments.

half_verses: When I was in trouble, I called to the LORD;
I called to the LORD, and he answered me.
verses.text: When I was in trouble, I called to the LORD; * I called to the LORD, and he answered me.

half_verses: Deliver me, O LORD, from lying lips
and from the deceitful tongue.
verses.text: Deliver me, O LORD, from lying lips * and from the deceitful tongue.

half_verses: What shall be done to you, and what more besides,
O you deceitful tongue?
verses.text: What shall be done to you, and what more besides, * O you deceitful tongue?

half_verses: The sharpened arrows of a warrior,
along with hot glowing coals.
verses.text: The sharpened arrows of a warrior, * along with hot glowing coals.

half_verses: How hateful it is that I must lodge in Meshech
and dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.text: How hateful it is that I must lodge in Meshech * and dwell among the tents of Kedar!

half_verses: Too long have I had to live
among the enemies of peace.
verses.text: Too long have I had to live * among the enemies of peace.

half_verses: I am on the side of peace,
but when I speak of it, they are for war.
verses.text: I am on the side of peace, * but when I speak of it, they are for war.

half_verses: I lift up my eyes to the hills;
from where is my help to come?
verses.text: I lift up my eyes to the hills; * from where is my help to come?

half_verses: My help comes from the LORD,
the maker of heaven and earth.
verses.text: My help comes from the LORD, * the maker of heaven and earth.

half_verses: He will not let your foot be moved
and he who watches over you will not fall asleep.
verses.text: He will not let your foot be moved * and he who watches over you will not fall asleep.

half_verses: Behold, he who keeps watch over Israel
shall neither slumber nor sleep;
verses.text: Behold, he who keeps watch over Israel * shall neither slumber nor sleep;

half_verses: The LORD himself watches over you;
the LORD is your shade at your right hand,
verses.text: The LORD himself watches over you; * the LORD is your shade at your right hand,

half_verses: So that the sun shall not strike you by day,
nor the moon by night.
verses.text: So that the sun shall not strike you by day, * nor the moon by night.

half_verses: The LORD shall preserve you from all evil;
it is he who shall keep you safe.
verses.text: The LORD shall preserve you from all evil; * it is he who shall keep you safe.

half_verses: The LORD shall watch over your going out and your coming in,
from this time forth for evermore.
verses.text: The LORD shall watch over your going out and your coming in, * from this time forth for evermore.

half_verses: I was glad when they said to me,
"Let us go to the house of the LORD."
verses.text: I was glad when they said to me, * "Let us go to the house of the LORD."

half_verses: Now our feet are standing
within your gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.text: Now our feet are standing * within your gates, O Jerusalem.

half_verses: Jerusalem is built as a city
that is at unity with itself;
verses.text: Jerusalem is built as a city * that is at unity with itself;

half_verses: To which the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD,
the assembly of Israel, to praise the Name of the LORD.
verses.text: To which the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, * the assembly of Israel, to praise the Name of the LORD.

half_verses: For there are the thrones of judgment,
the thrones of the house of David.
verses.text: For there are the thrones of judgment, * the thrones of the house of David.

half_verses: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem:
"May they prosper who love you.
verses.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: * "May they prosper who love you.

half_verses: Peace be within your walls
and quietness within your towers.
verses.text: Peace be within your walls * and quietness within your towers.

half_verses: For my brethren and companions' sake,
I pray for your prosperity.
verses.text: For my brethren and companions' sake, * I pray for your prosperity.

half_verses: Because of the house of the LORD our God,
I will seek to do you good."
verses.text: Because of the house of the LORD our God, * I will seek to do you good."

half_verses: To you I lift up my eyes,
to you enthroned in the heavens.
verses.text: To you I lift up my eyes, * to you enthroned in the heavens.

half_verses: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters,
and the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,
verses.text: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters, * and the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,

half_verses: So our eyes look to the LORD our God,
until he show us his mercy.
verses.text: So our eyes look to the LORD our God, * until he show us his mercy.

half_verses: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy,
for we have had more than enough of contempt,
verses.text: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy, * for we have had more than enough of contempt,

half_verses: Too much of the scorn of the indolent rich,
and of the derision of the proud.
verses.text: Too much of the scorn of the indolent rich, * and of the derision of the proud.

half_verses: If the LORD had not been on our side,
let Israel now say;
verses.text: If the LORD had not been on our side, * let Israel now say;

half_verses: If the LORD had not been on our side,
when enemies rose up against us;
verses.text: If the LORD had not been on our side, * when enemies rose up against us;

half_verses: Then would they have swallowed us up alive
in their fierce anger toward us;
verses.text: Then would they have swallowed us up alive * in their fierce anger toward us;

half_verses: Then would the waters have overwhelmed us
and the torrent gone over us;
verses.text: Then would the waters have overwhelmed us * and the torrent gone over us;

half_verses: Then would the raging waters
have gone right over us.
verses.text: Then would the raging waters * have gone right over us.

half_verses: Blessed be the LORD!
he has not given us over to be a prey for their teeth.
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD! * he has not given us over to be a prey for their teeth.

half_verses: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler;
the snare is broken, and we have escaped.
verses.text: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; * the snare is broken, and we have escaped.

half_verses: Our help is in the Name of the LORD,
the maker of heaven and earth.
verses.text: Our help is in the Name of the LORD, * the maker of heaven and earth.

half_verses: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion,
which cannot be moved, but stands fast for ever.
verses.text: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, * which cannot be moved, but stands fast for ever.

half_verses: The hills stand about Jerusalem;
so does the LORD stand round about his people, from this time forth for evermore.
verses.text: The hills stand about Jerusalem; * so does the LORD stand round about his people, from this time forth for evermore.

half_verses: The scepter of the wicked shall not hold sway over the land allotted to the just,
so that the just shall not put their hands to evil.
verses.text: The scepter of the wicked shall not hold sway over the land allotted to the just, * so that the just shall not put their hands to evil.

half_verses: Show your goodness, O LORD, to those who are good
and to those who are true of heart.
verses.text: Show your goodness, O LORD, to those who are good * and to those who are true of heart.

half_verses: As for those who turn aside to crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the evildoers;
but peace be upon Israel.
verses.text: As for those who turn aside to crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the evildoers; * but peace be upon Israel.

half_verses: When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion,
then were we like those who dream.
verses.text: When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, * then were we like those who dream.

half_verses: Then was our mouth filled with laughter,
and our tongue with shouts of joy.
verses.text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, * and our tongue with shouts of joy.

half_verses: Then they said among the nations,
"The LORD has done great things for them."
verses.text: Then they said among the nations, * "The LORD has done great things for them."

half_verses: The LORD has done great things for us,
and we are glad indeed.
verses.text: The LORD has done great things for us, * and we are glad indeed.

half_verses: Restore our fortunes, O LORD,
like the watercourses of the Negev.
verses.text: Restore our fortunes, O LORD, * like the watercourses of the Negev.

half_verses: Those who sowed with tears
will reap with songs of joy.
verses.text: Those who sowed with tears * will reap with songs of joy.

half_verses: Those who go out weeping, carrying the seed,
will come again with joy, shouldering their sheaves.
verses.text: Those who go out weeping, carrying the seed, * will come again with joy, shouldering their sheaves.

half_verses: Unless the LORD builds the house,
their labor is in vain who build it.
verses.text: Unless the LORD builds the house, * their labor is in vain who build it.

half_verses: Unless the LORD watches over the city,
in vain the watchman keeps his vigil.
verses.text: Unless the LORD watches over the city, * in vain the watchman keeps his vigil.

half_verses: It is in vain that you rise so early and go to bed so late;
vain, too, to eat the bread of toil, for he gives to his beloved sleep.
verses.text: It is in vain that you rise so early and go to bed so late; * vain, too, to eat the bread of toil, for he gives to his beloved sleep.

half_verses: Children are a heritage from the LORD,
and the fruit of the womb is a gift.
verses.text: Children are a heritage from the LORD, * and the fruit of the womb is a gift.

half_verses: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior
are the children of one's youth.
verses.text: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior * are the children of one's youth.

half_verses: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them!
he shall not be put to shame when he contends with his enemies in the gate.
verses.text: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them! * he shall not be put to shame when he contends with his enemies in the gate.

half_verses: Happy are they all who fear the LORD,
and who follow in his ways!
verses.text: Happy are they all who fear the LORD, * and who follow in his ways!

half_verses: You shall eat the fruit of your labor;
happiness and prosperity shall be yours.
verses.text: You shall eat the fruit of your labor; * happiness and prosperity shall be yours.

half_verses: Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine within your house,
your children like olive shoots round about your table.
verses.text: Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine within your house, * your children like olive shoots round about your table.

half_verses: The man who fears the LORD
shall thus indeed be blessed.
verses.text: The man who fears the LORD * shall thus indeed be blessed.

half_verses: The LORD bless you from Zion,
and may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.text: The LORD bless you from Zion, * and may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

half_verses: May you live to see your children's children;
may peace be upon Israel.
verses.text: May you live to see your children's children; * may peace be upon Israel.

half_verses: "Greatly have they oppressed me since my youth,"
let Israel now say;
verses.text: "Greatly have they oppressed me since my youth," * let Israel now say;

half_verses: "Greatly have they oppressed me since my youth,
but they have not prevailed against me."
verses.text: "Greatly have they oppressed me since my youth, * but they have not prevailed against me."

half_verses: The plowmen plowed upon my back
and made their furrows long.
verses.text: The plowmen plowed upon my back * and made their furrows long.

half_verses: The LORD, the Righteous One,
has cut the cords of the wicked.
verses.text: The LORD, the Righteous One, * has cut the cords of the wicked.

half_verses: Let them be put to shame and thrown back,
all those who are enemies of Zion.
verses.text: Let them be put to shame and thrown back, * all those who are enemies of Zion.

half_verses: Let them be like grass upon the housetops,
which withers before it can be plucked;
verses.text: Let them be like grass upon the housetops, * which withers before it can be plucked;

half_verses: Which does not fill the hand of the reaper,
nor the bosom of him who binds the sheaves;
verses.text: Which does not fill the hand of the reaper, * nor the bosom of him who binds the sheaves;

half_verses: So that those who go by say not so much as, "The LORD prosper you.
We wish you well in the Name of the LORD."
verses.text: So that those who go by say not so much as, "The LORD prosper you. * We wish you well in the Name of the LORD."

half_verses: Out of the depths have I called to you, O LORD; LORD, hear my voice;
let your ears consider well the voice of my supplication.
verses.text: Out of the depths have I called to you, O LORD; LORD, hear my voice; * let your ears consider well the voice of my supplication.

half_verses: If you, LORD, were to note what is done amiss,
O LORD, who could stand?
verses.text: If you, LORD, were to note what is done amiss, * O LORD, who could stand?

half_verses: For there is forgiveness with you;
therefore you shall be feared.
verses.text: For there is forgiveness with you; * therefore you shall be feared.

half_verses: I wait for the LORD; my soul waits for him;
in his word is my hope.
verses.text: I wait for the LORD; my soul waits for him; * in his word is my hope.

half_verses: My soul waits for the LORD, more than watchmen for the morning,
more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.text: My soul waits for the LORD, more than watchmen for the morning, * more than watchmen for the morning.

half_verses: O Israel, wait for the LORD,
for with the LORD there is mercy;
verses.text: O Israel, wait for the LORD, * for with the LORD there is mercy;

half_verses: With him there is plenteous redemption,
and he shall redeem Israel from all their sins.
verses.text: With him there is plenteous redemption, * and he shall redeem Israel from all their sins.

half_verses: O LORD, I am not proud;
I have no haughty looks.
verses.text: O LORD, I am not proud; * I have no haughty looks.

half_verses: I do not occupy myself with great matters,
or with things that are too hard for me.
verses.text: I do not occupy myself with great matters, * or with things that are too hard for me.

half_verses: But I still my soul and make it quiet, like a child upon its mother's breast;
my soul is quieted within me.
verses.text: But I still my soul and make it quiet, like a child upon its mother's breast; * my soul is quieted within me.

half_verses: O Israel, wait upon the LORD,
from this time forth for evermore.
verses.text: O Israel, wait upon the LORD, * from this time forth for evermore.

half_verses: LORD, remember David,
and all the hardships he endured;
verses.text: LORD, remember David, * and all the hardships he endured;

half_verses: How he swore an oath to the LORD
and vowed a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.text: How he swore an oath to the LORD * and vowed a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

half_verses: "I will not come under the roof of my house,
nor climb up into my bed;
verses.text: "I will not come under the roof of my house, * nor climb up into my bed;

half_verses: I will not allow my eyes to sleep,
nor let my eyelids slumber;
verses.text: I will not allow my eyes to sleep, * nor let my eyelids slumber;

half_verses: Until I find a place for the LORD,
a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.text: Until I find a place for the LORD, * a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."

half_verses: "The ark! We heard it was in Ephratah;
we found it in the fields of Jearim.
verses.text: "The ark! We heard it was in Ephratah; * we found it in the fields of Jearim.

half_verses: Let us go to God's dwelling place;
let us fall upon our knees before his footstool."
verses.text: Let us go to God's dwelling place; * let us fall upon our knees before his footstool."

half_verses: Arise, O LORD, into your resting-place,
you and the ark of your strength.
verses.text: Arise, O LORD, into your resting-place, * you and the ark of your strength.

half_verses: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness;
let your faithful people sing with joy.
verses.text: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; * let your faithful people sing with joy.

half_verses: For your servant David's sake,
do not turn away the face of your Anointed.
verses.text: For your servant David's sake, * do not turn away the face of your Anointed.

half_verses: The LORD has sworn an oath to David;
in truth, he will not break it:
verses.text: The LORD has sworn an oath to David; * in truth, he will not break it:

half_verses: "A son, the fruit of your body
will I set upon your throne.
verses.text: "A son, the fruit of your body * will I set upon your throne.

half_verses: If your children keep my covenant and my testimonies that I shall teach them,
their children will sit upon your throne for evermore."
verses.text: If your children keep my covenant and my testimonies that I shall teach them, * their children will sit upon your throne for evermore."

half_verses: For the LORD has chosen Zion;
he has desired her for his habitation:
verses.text: For the LORD has chosen Zion; * he has desired her for his habitation:

half_verses: "This shall be my resting-place for ever;
here will I dwell, for I delight in her.
verses.text: "This shall be my resting-place for ever; * here will I dwell, for I delight in her.

half_verses: I will surely bless her provisions,
and satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.text: I will surely bless her provisions, * and satisfy her poor with bread.

half_verses: I will clothe her priests with salvation,
and her faithful people will rejoice and sing.
verses.text: I will clothe her priests with salvation, * and her faithful people will rejoice and sing.

half_verses: There will I make the horn of David flourish;
I have prepared a lamp for my Anointed.
verses.text: There will I make the horn of David flourish; * I have prepared a lamp for my Anointed.

half_verses: As for his enemies, I will clothe them with shame;
but as for him, his crown will shine."
verses.text: As for his enemies, I will clothe them with shame; * but as for him, his crown will shine."

half_verses: Oh, how good and pleasant it is,
when brethren live together in unity!
verses.text: Oh, how good and pleasant it is, * when brethren live together in unity!

half_verses: It is like fine oil upon the head
that runs down upon the beard,
verses.text: It is like fine oil upon the head * that runs down upon the beard,

half_verses: Upon the beard of Aaron,
and runs down upon the collar of his robe.
verses.text: Upon the beard of Aaron, * and runs down upon the collar of his robe.

half_verses: It is like the dew of Hermon
that falls upon the hills of Zion.
verses.text: It is like the dew of Hermon * that falls upon the hills of Zion.

half_verses: For there the LORD has ordained the blessing:
life for evermore.
verses.text: For there the LORD has ordained the blessing: * life for evermore.

half_verses: Behold now, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD,
you that stand by night in the house of the LORD.
verses.text: Behold now, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, * you that stand by night in the house of the LORD.

half_verses: Lift up your hands in the holy place and bless the LORD;
the LORD who made heaven and earth bless you out of Zion.
verses.text: Lift up your hands in the holy place and bless the LORD; * the LORD who made heaven and earth bless you out of Zion.

half_verses: Hallelujah! Praise the Name of the LORD;
give praise, you servants of the LORD.
verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the Name of the LORD; * give praise, you servants of the LORD.

half_verses: You who stand in the house of the LORD,
in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.text: You who stand in the house of the LORD, * in the courts of the house of our God.

half_verses: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good;
sing praises to his Name, for it is lovely.
verses.text: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; * sing praises to his Name, for it is lovely.

half_verses: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself
and Israel for his own possession.
verses.text: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself * and Israel for his own possession.

half_verses: For I know that the LORD is great,
and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.text: For I know that the LORD is great, * and that our Lord is above all gods.

half_verses: The LORD does whatever pleases him, in heaven and on earth,
in the seas and all the deeps.
verses.text: The LORD does whatever pleases him, in heaven and on earth, * in the seas and all the deeps.

half_verses: He brings up rain clouds from the ends of the earth;
he sends out lightning with the rain, and brings the winds out of his storehouse.
verses.text: He brings up rain clouds from the ends of the earth; * he sends out lightning with the rain, and brings the winds out of his storehouse.

half_verses: It was he who struck down the firstborn of Egypt,
the firstborn both of man and beast.
verses.text: It was he who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, * the firstborn both of man and beast.

half_verses: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt,
against Pharaoh and all his servants.
verses.text: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt, * against Pharaoh and all his servants.

half_verses: He overthrew many nations
and put mighty kings to death:
verses.text: He overthrew many nations * and put mighty kings to death:

half_verses: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, the king of Bashan,
and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
verses.text: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, the king of Bashan, * and all the kingdoms of Canaan.

half_verses: He gave their land to be an inheritance,
an inheritance for Israel his people.
verses.text: He gave their land to be an inheritance, * an inheritance for Israel his people.

half_verses: O LORD, your Name is everlasting;
your renown, O LORD, endures from age to age.
verses.text: O LORD, your Name is everlasting; * your renown, O LORD, endures from age to age.

half_verses: For the LORD gives his people justice
and shows compassion to his servants.
verses.text: For the LORD gives his people justice * and shows compassion to his servants.

half_verses: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold,
the work of human hands.
verses.text: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, * the work of human hands.

half_verses: They have mouths, but they cannot speak;
eyes have they, but they cannot see.
verses.text: They have mouths, but they cannot speak; * eyes have they, but they cannot see.

half_verses: They have ears, but they cannot hear;
neither is there any breath in their mouth.
verses.text: They have ears, but they cannot hear; * neither is there any breath in their mouth.

half_verses: Those who make them are like them,
and so are all who put their trust in them.
verses.text: Those who make them are like them, * and so are all who put their trust in them.

half_verses: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel;
O house of Aaron, bless the LORD.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel; * O house of Aaron, bless the LORD.

half_verses: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi;
you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
verses.text: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi; * you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

half_verses: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion,
who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, * who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!

half_verses: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good,
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, * for his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Give thanks to the God of gods,
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the God of gods, * for his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Give thanks to the Lord of lords,
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, * for his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Who only does great wonders,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who only does great wonders, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: Who by wisdom made the heavens,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who by wisdom made the heavens, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: Who spread out the earth upon the waters,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who spread out the earth upon the waters, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: Who created great lights,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who created great lights, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: The sun to rule the day,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: The sun to rule the day, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: The moon and the stars to govern the night,
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: The moon and the stars to govern the night, * for his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Who struck down the firstborn of Egypt,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: And brought out Israel from among them,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And brought out Israel from among them, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: With a mighty hand and a stretched-out arm,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: With a mighty hand and a stretched-out arm, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: Who divided the Red Sea in two,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who divided the Red Sea in two, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: But swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: But swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: Who led his people through the wilderness,
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Who led his people through the wilderness, * for his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Who struck down great kings,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who struck down great kings, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: And slew mighty kings,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And slew mighty kings, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: Sihon, king of the Amorites,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Sihon, king of the Amorites, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: And Og, the king of Bashan,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And Og, the king of Bashan, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: And gave away their lands for an inheritance,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And gave away their lands for an inheritance, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: An inheritance for Israel his servant,
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: An inheritance for Israel his servant, * for his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Who remembered us in our low estate,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: Who remembered us in our low estate, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: And delivered us from our enemies,
for his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And delivered us from our enemies, * for his mercy endures for ever;

half_verses: Who gives food to all creatures,
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Who gives food to all creatures, * for his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: Give thanks to the God of heaven,
for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Give thanks to the God of heaven, * for his mercy endures for ever.

half_verses: By the waters of Babylon we sat down and wept,
when we remembered you, O Zion.
verses.text: By the waters of Babylon we sat down and wept, * when we remembered you, O Zion.

half_verses: As for our harps, we hung them up
on the trees in the midst of that land.
verses.text: As for our harps, we hung them up * on the trees in the midst of that land.

half_verses: For those who led us away captive asked us for a song, and our oppressors called for mirth:
"Sing us one of the songs of Zion."
verses.text: For those who led us away captive asked us for a song, and our oppressors called for mirth: * "Sing us one of the songs of Zion."

half_verses: How shall we sing the LORD'S song
upon an alien soil?
verses.text: How shall we sing the LORD'S song * upon an alien soil?

half_verses: If I forget you, O Jerusalem,
let my right hand forget its skill.
verses.text: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, * let my right hand forget its skill.

half_verses: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you,
if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy.
verses.text: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, * if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy.

half_verses: Remember the day of Jerusalem, O LORD, against the people of Edom,
who said, "Down with it! down with it! even to the ground!"
verses.text: Remember the day of Jerusalem, O LORD, against the people of Edom, * who said, "Down with it! down with it! even to the ground!"

half_verses: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction,
happy the one who pays you back for what you have done to us!
verses.text: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, * happy the one who pays you back for what you have done to us!

half_verses: Happy shall he be who takes your little ones,
and dashes them against the rock!
verses.text: Happy shall he be who takes your little ones, * and dashes them against the rock!

half_verses: I will give thanks to you, O LORD, with my whole heart;
before the gods I will sing your praise.
verses.text: I will give thanks to you, O LORD, with my whole heart; * before the gods I will sing your praise.

half_verses: I will bow down toward your holy temple and praise your Name,
because of your love and faithfulness;
verses.text: I will bow down toward your holy temple and praise your Name, * because of your love and faithfulness;

half_verses: For you have glorified your Name
and your word above all things.
verses.text: For you have glorified your Name * and your word above all things.

half_verses: When I called, you answered me;
you increased my strength within me.
verses.text: When I called, you answered me; * you increased my strength within me.

half_verses: All the kings of the earth will praise you, O LORD,
when they have heard the words of your mouth.
verses.text: All the kings of the earth will praise you, O LORD, * when they have heard the words of your mouth.

half_verses: They will sing of the ways of the LORD,
that great is the glory of the LORD.
verses.text: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, * that great is the glory of the LORD.

half_verses: Though the LORD be high, he cares for the lowly;
he perceives the haughty from afar.
verses.text: Though the LORD be high, he cares for the lowly; * he perceives the haughty from afar.

half_verses: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you keep me safe;
you stretch forth your hand against the fury of my enemies; your right hand shall save me.
verses.text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you keep me safe; * you stretch forth your hand against the fury of my enemies; your right hand shall save me.

half_verses: The LORD will make good his purpose for me;
O LORD, your love endures for ever; do not abandon the works of your hands.
verses.text: The LORD will make good his purpose for me; * O LORD, your love endures for ever; do not abandon the works of your hands.

half_verses: LORD, you have searched me out and known me;
you know my sitting down and my rising up; you discern my thoughts from afar.
verses.text: LORD, you have searched me out and known me; * you know my sitting down and my rising up; you discern my thoughts from afar.

half_verses: You trace my journeys and my resting-places
and are acquainted with all my ways.
verses.text: You trace my journeys and my resting-places * and are acquainted with all my ways.

half_verses: Indeed, there is not a word on my lips,
but you, O LORD, know it altogether.
verses.text: Indeed, there is not a word on my lips, * but you, O LORD, know it altogether.

half_verses: You press upon me behind and before
and lay your hand upon me.
verses.text: You press upon me behind and before * and lay your hand upon me.

half_verses: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me;
it is so high that I cannot attain to it.
verses.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; * it is so high that I cannot attain to it.

half_verses: Where can I go then from your Spirit?
where can I flee from your presence?
verses.text: Where can I go then from your Spirit? * where can I flee from your presence?

half_verses: If I climb up to heaven, you are there;
if I make the grave my bed, you are there also.
verses.text: If I climb up to heaven, you are there; * if I make the grave my bed, you are there also.

half_verses: If I take the wings of the morning
and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,
verses.text: If I take the wings of the morning * and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,

half_verses: Even there your hand will lead me
and your right hand hold me fast.
verses.text: Even there your hand will lead me * and your right hand hold me fast.

half_verses: If I say, "Surely the darkness will cover me,
and the light around me turn to night,"
verses.text: If I say, "Surely the darkness will cover me, * and the light around me turn to night,"

half_verses: Darkness is not dark to you; the night is as bright as the day;
darkness and light to you are both alike.
verses.text: Darkness is not dark to you; the night is as bright as the day; * darkness and light to you are both alike.

half_verses: For you yourself created my inmost parts;
you knit me together in my mother's womb.
verses.text: For you yourself created my inmost parts; * you knit me together in my mother's womb.

half_verses: I will thank you because I am marvelously made;
your works are wonderful, and I know it well.
verses.text: I will thank you because I am marvelously made; * your works are wonderful, and I know it well.

half_verses: My body was not hidden from you,
while I was being made in secret and woven in the depths of the earth.
verses.text: My body was not hidden from you, * while I was being made in secret and woven in the depths of the earth.

half_verses: Your eyes beheld my limbs, yet unfinished in the womb; all of them were written in your book;
they were fashioned day by day, when as yet there was none of them.
verses.text: Your eyes beheld my limbs, yet unfinished in the womb; all of them were written in your book; * they were fashioned day by day, when as yet there was none of them.

half_verses: How deep I find your thoughts, O God!
how great is the sum of them!
verses.text: How deep I find your thoughts, O God! * how great is the sum of them!

half_verses: If I were to count them, they would be more in number than the sand;
to count them all, my life span would need to be like yours.
verses.text: If I were to count them, they would be more in number than the sand; * to count them all, my life span would need to be like yours.

half_verses: Oh, that you would slay the wicked, O God!
You that thirst for blood, depart from me.
verses.text: Oh, that you would slay the wicked, O God! * You that thirst for blood, depart from me.

half_verses: They speak despitefully against you;
your enemies take your Name in vain.
verses.text: They speak despitefully against you; * your enemies take your Name in vain.

half_verses: Do I not hate those, O LORD, who hate you?
and do I not loathe those who rise up against you?
verses.text: Do I not hate those, O LORD, who hate you? * and do I not loathe those who rise up against you?

half_verses: I hate them with a perfect hatred;
they have become my own enemies.
verses.text: I hate them with a perfect hatred; * they have become my own enemies.

half_verses: Search me out, O God, and know my heart;
try me and know my restless thoughts.
verses.text: Search me out, O God, and know my heart; * try me and know my restless thoughts.

half_verses: Look well whether there be any wickedness in me
and lead me in the way that is everlasting.
verses.text: Look well whether there be any wickedness in me * and lead me in the way that is everlasting.

half_verses: Deliver me, O LORD, from evildoers;
protect me from the violent,
verses.text: Deliver me, O LORD, from evildoers; * protect me from the violent,

half_verses: Who devise evil in their hearts
and stir up strife all day long.
verses.text: Who devise evil in their hearts * and stir up strife all day long.

half_verses: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent;
adder's poison is under their lips.
verses.text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; * adder's poison is under their lips.

half_verses: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked;
protect me from the violent, who are determined to trip me up.
verses.text: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; * protect me from the violent, who are determined to trip me up.

half_verses: The proud have hidden a snare for me and stretched out a net of cords;
they have set traps for me along the path.
verses.text: The proud have hidden a snare for me and stretched out a net of cords; * they have set traps for me along the path.

half_verses: I have said to the LORD, "You are my God;
listen, O LORD, to my supplication.
verses.text: I have said to the LORD, "You are my God; * listen, O LORD, to my supplication.

half_verses: O Lord GOD, the strength of my salvation,
you have covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.text: O Lord GOD, the strength of my salvation, * you have covered my head in the day of battle.

half_verses: Do not grant the desires of the wicked, O LORD,
nor let their evil plans prosper.
verses.text: Do not grant the desires of the wicked, O LORD, * nor let their evil plans prosper.

half_verses: Let not those who surround me lift up their heads;
let the evil of their lips overwhelm them.
verses.text: Let not those who surround me lift up their heads; * let the evil of their lips overwhelm them.

half_verses: Let hot burning coals fall upon them;
let them be cast into the mire, never to rise up again."
verses.text: Let hot burning coals fall upon them; * let them be cast into the mire, never to rise up again."
